verses.1:1: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan, in the wilderness, toward the west, near the Red Sea, between Paran, Tophel, Laban, Aulon, and Catachrysea.
verses.1:2: Eleven days in Horeb is the way to Mount
verses.1:3: Seir, as far as Kadesh Barnea. And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spoke to all the sons of Israel according to all that the Lord had commanded him for them, after striking down
verses.1:4: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and Og king of Bashan, who dwelt in Ashtaroth and in Edrei,
verses.1:5: on the far side of the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to expound this law, saying:
verses.1:6: The Lord our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, "Let it suffice for you to dwell at this mountain.
verses.1:7: Turn and set out, and enter into the mountain of the Amorites, and to all those who dwell around the Arabah, to the mountain and the plain, and toward the south, and the coastal land of the Canaanites, and Antilibanus, as far as the great river, the Euphrates.
verses.1:8: Behold, He has delivered the land before you; go in and inherit the land which I swore to your fathers, to Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, to give to them and to their seed after them."
verses.1:9: And I spoke to you at that time, saying, "I shall not be able to bear you alone.
verses.1:10: The Lord your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today like the stars of heaven in multitude.
verses.1:11: May the Lord, the God of your fathers, add to you a thousandfold more than you are, and bless you just as He has spoken to you.
verses.1:12: How shall I alone be able to bear your toil, and your burden, and your contentions?
verses.1:13: Provide for yourselves wise, knowledgeable, and discerning men for your tribes, and I will appoint them over you as your leaders."
verses.1:14: And you answered me and said, "The word which you have spoken to do is good."
verses.1:15: And I took from among you wise, knowledgeable, and discerning men, and appointed them to rule over you: commanders of thousands, and commanders of hundreds, and commanders of tens, and recorders for your judges.
verses.1:16: And I commanded your judges at that time, saying, "Give a full hearing between your brethren, and judge righteously between a man and a brother, and his sojourner.
verses.1:17: You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall judge the small and the great alike; you shall by no means shrink before the face of man, for judgment belongs to God. And whatever matter is too hard for you, you shall bring it up to me, and I will hear you."
verses.1:18: And I commanded you at that time all the words which you should perform.
verses.1:19: And setting out from Horeb, we journeyed through all that great and fearful wilderness which you saw, by the way of the mountain of the Amorite, just as the Lord our God commanded us; and we came as far as Kadesh Barnea.
verses.1:20: And I said to you, "You have come as far as the mountain of the Amorite, which the Lord our God is giving you.
verses.1:21: Behold, the Lord our God has delivered the land to you before your face; go up and inherit it, in the manner that the Lord, the God of our fathers, has spoken to you. Do not fear, nor be dismayed."
verses.1:22: And you all approached me and said, "Let us send men ahead of us, and let them explore the land for us, and bring back a report to us concerning the way by which we shall go up, and the cities into which we shall enter."
verses.1:23: And the word was pleasing in my sight, and I took from among you twelve men, one man for each tribe.
verses.1:24: And turning, they went up into the mountain, and came as far as the Valley of the Cluster, and spied it out.
verses.1:25: And they took in their hands some of the fruit of the land and brought it down to us, and said, "Good is the land which the Lord our God is giving us."
verses.1:26: Yet you were not willing to go up, and you disobeyed the word of the Lord our God;
verses.1:27: and you murmured in your tents and said, "Because the Lord hates us, He brought us out of the land of Egypt to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites, to utterly destroy us.
verses.1:28: Where are we going up?" Your brethren turned away your heart, saying, "A nation great and numerous and mightier than you, and cities great and fortified up to heaven; moreover, we have also seen sons of giants there."
verses.1:29: And I said to you, "Do not be terrified, nor be afraid of them.
verses.1:30: The Lord your God, who goes before your face, He Himself shall fight against them together with you, according to all that He did for us in the land of Egypt, and in this wilderness which you saw, by the way of the mountain of the Amorite, how the Lord
verses.1:31: your God nurtured you, as a man nurtures his own son, along all the way in which you walked until you came to this place."
verses.1:32: Yet in this matter you did not trust in the Lord our God,
verses.1:33: who goes ahead of you in the way to choose a place for you, guiding you in fire by night, showing you the way in which you should walk, and in a cloud by day.
verses.1:34: And the Lord heard the voice of your words, and being provoked to wrath, He swore, saying,
verses.1:35: "Surely not one of these men shall see this good land which I swore to their fathers,
verses.1:36: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him I will give the land on which he walked, and to his sons, because he was devoted to the things pertaining to the Lord."
verses.1:37: The Lord was also angry with me on your account, saying, "You also shall by no means enter there.
verses.1:38: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, he shall enter there; strengthen him, for he shall apportion it as an inheritance to Israel.
verses.1:39: And every young child who today does not know good or evil, these shall enter there, and to them I will give it, and they shall inherit it."
verses.1:40: And you turned and encamped toward the wilderness, by the way to the Red Sea.
verses.1:41: And you answered me and said, "We have sinned before the Lord our God; we will go up and fight according to all that the Lord our God has commanded us." And each man took up his weapons of war, and gathering together, you went up into the mountain.
verses.1:42: And the Lord said to me, "Say to them, 'You shall not go up, nor shall you fight, for I am not with you; and you shall not be crushed before your enemies.'"
verses.1:43: And I spoke to you, and you did not listen to me; and you transgressed the word of the Lord, and forcing your way, you went up into the mountain.
verses.1:44: And the Amorite who dwelt in that mountain came out to meet you, and they pursued you just as bees would do, and wounded you from Seir as far as Hormah.
verses.1:45: And sitting down, you wept before the Lord our God; yet the Lord did not listen to your voice, nor did He pay attention to you.
verses.1:46: And you abode in Kadesh many days, as many days as you abode there.
verses.2:1: Then we turned back and set out into the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea, just as the Lord spoke to me, and we went around Mount Seir for many days.
verses.2:2: And the Lord said to me,
verses.2:3: "Let it be enough for you to go around this mountain; turn therefore toward the north.
verses.2:4: And command the people, saying, 'You are passing through the borders of your brethren, the sons of Esau, who dwell in Seir, and they will fear you and dread you exceedingly.
verses.2:5: Do not engage in war against them, for I will by no means give you any of their land, not even a footstep, because I have given Mount Seir as an inheritance to the sons of Esau.
verses.2:6: Buy food from them with silver and you shall eat, and obtain water from them by measure for silver and you shall drink;
verses.2:7: for the Lord our God has blessed you in every work of your hands. Consider how you passed through that great and fearful wilderness; behold, for forty years the Lord your God has been with you, and you have not lacked a thing.'"
verses.2:8: And we passed by your brethren, the sons of Esau who dwell in Seir, along the way of the Arabah from Ailon and from Ezion Geber; and having turned, we passed along the wilderness way of Moab.
verses.2:9: And the Lord said to me, "Do not be hostile toward the Moabites, and do not engage in war against them; for I will by no means give you any of their land as an inheritance, because I have given Seir to the sons of Lot to inherit."
verses.2:10: The Emim formerly dwelt in it, a great and numerous nation, and mighty like the Anakim;
verses.2:11: these also shall be reckoned as Rephaim, like the Anakim; and the Moabites call them Emim.
verses.2:12: And the Horites formerly dwelt in Seir, and the sons of Esau destroyed them and blotted them out from before their face, and settled in their place—just as Israel did to the land of his inheritance, which the Lord gave to them.
verses.2:13: "Now therefore, arise and set out, and cross over the valley of Zered." So we crossed over the valley of Zered.
verses.2:14: And the days in which we journeyed from Kadesh Barnea until we crossed over the valley of Zered were thirty-eight years, until the entire generation of the men of war perished, dying out from the camp, just as God had sworn to them.
verses.2:15: And the hand of God was against them to consume them from the midst of the camp, until they perished.
verses.2:16: And it came to pass, when all the men of war had perished, dying out from the midst of the people,
verses.2:17: that the Lord spoke to me, saying,
verses.2:18: "Today you shall pass over the borders of Moab, even Seir,
verses.2:19: and you shall draw near to the sons of Ammon. Do not be hostile toward them, and do not engage with them in war; for I will by no means give you any of the land of the sons of Ammon as an inheritance, because I have given it to the sons of Lot as an inheritance."
verses.2:20: It shall be reckoned a land of Rephaim, for the Rephaim dwelt in it formerly, and the Ammonites call them Zochomin,
verses.2:21: a great and numerous nation, and mightier than you, like the Anakim; yet the Lord destroyed them before their face, and they took possession and settled in their place until this day—
verses.2:22: just as they did for the sons of Esau who dwell in Seir, in the manner that they blotted out the Horites from before their face, and took possession and settled in their place until this day;
verses.2:23: and as for the Hivites who dwelt in Asedoth as far as Gaza, the Cappadocians who came out of Cappadocia blotted them out and settled in their place.
verses.2:24: "Now therefore, arise and set out, and cross over the valley of Arnon. Behold, I have delivered into your hands Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to inherit it, and engage in war against him. On this day
verses.2:25: begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you upon the face of all the nations under heaven, who upon hearing your name shall be troubled, and shall have pangs of anguish from before your face."
verses.2:26: And I sent envoys from the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
verses.2:27: "I will pass through your land; I will pass along the road, and I will not turn aside to the right or to the left.
verses.2:28: You shall sell me food for silver and I shall eat, and you shall sell me water for silver and I shall drink; only I will pass through on foot,
verses.2:29: just as the sons of Esau who dwell in Seir and the Moabites who dwell in Aroer did for me, until I cross over the Jordan into the land which the Lord our God is giving to us."
verses.2:30: Yet Sihon king of Heshbon was not willing for us to pass by him, because the Lord our God hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, so that he might be delivered into your hands, as on this day.
verses.2:31: And the Lord said to me, "Behold, I have begun to deliver before your face Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to inherit his land."
verses.2:32: Then Sihon king of Heshbon came out to meet us, he and all his people, for battle at Jahaz.
verses.2:33: And the Lord our God delivered him before our face, and He struck down him and his sons and all his people.
verses.2:34: And we captured all his cities at that time, and we utterly destroyed every city in turn, and their women and their children; we left no one alive.
verses.2:35: Only the livestock we took as plunder, and the spoil of the cities we seized,
verses.2:36: from Aroer, which is along the bank of the brook Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even as far as Mount Gilead; there was not a city that escaped us, for the Lord our God delivered them all into our hands.
verses.2:37: Only we did not come near the sons of Ammon—all the areas bordering the brook Jabbok and the cities in the hill country—just as the Lord our God commanded us.
verses.3:1: Then we turned and went up by the way to Bashan; and Gog king of Bashan came out to meet us, he and all his people, for battle at Edrei.
verses.3:2: And the Lord said to me, "Do not fear him, for I have delivered him and all his people and all his land into your hands; and you shall do to him just as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon."
verses.3:3: So the Lord our God delivered him into our hands, even Og king of Bashan and all his people; and we struck him down until we left no seed of his.
verses.3:4: And we captured all his cities at that time; there was not a city that we did not take from them—sixty cities, all the adjoining regions of Argob, belonging to King Og in Bashan;
verses.3:5: all fortified cities, with high walls, gates, and bars, besides the cities of the Perizzites, which were exceedingly many.
verses.3:6: We utterly destroyed them, just as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, and we utterly destroyed every city in turn, and the women and the little children,
verses.3:7: and all the livestock; and the spoil of the cities we took as plunder for ourselves.
verses.3:8: And at that time we took the land from the hands of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the brook Arnon even as far as Hermon—
verses.3:9: the Phoenicians call Hermon Sanior, and the Amorites called it Senir—
verses.3:10: all the cities of Misor, and all Gilead, and all Bashan as far as Elcha and Edrei, royal cities of Og in Bashan.
verses.3:11: For only Og king of Bashan was left of the Rephaim. Behold, his bed was a bed of iron; behold, it is in the citadel of the sons of Ammon; nine cubits is its length and four cubits its width, according to the cubit of a man.
verses.3:12: And that land we took as plunder at that time, from Aroer, which is on the bank of the brook Arnon, and half of Mount Gilead; and its cities I gave to Reuben and to Gad.
verses.3:13: And the rest of Gilead and all Bashan, the kingdom of Gog, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh, even all the region of Argob; all that land of Bashan shall be reckoned a land of Rephaim.
verses.3:14: And Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Arbok as far as the borders of Gartasi and Homachathi; he named them after his own name—Basemath, Havvoth Jair—until this day.
verses.3:15: And to Machir I gave Gilead.
verses.3:16: And to Reuben and to Gad I have given from Gilead as far as the brook Arnon, and as far as the Jabbok—the brook being the border for the sons of Ammon—
verses.3:17: and the Arabah and the Jordan, the border of Machanareth, even as far as the Sea of Arabah, the Salt Sea, below Ashdoth Pisgah on the east.
verses.3:18: And I commanded you at that time, saying, "The Lord our God has given you this land as an inheritance; armed, you shall go before the face of your brethren, the sons of Israel, every mighty man.
verses.3:19: Only your wives and your children and your livestock—I know that you have much livestock—let them dwell in your cities which I have given you, until the Lord
verses.3:20: your God gives rest to your brethren as well as to you, and they also inherit the land which the Lord our God is giving to them beyond the Jordan; and you shall return, each man to his inheritance which I have given you."
verses.3:21: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, "Your eyes have seen all that the Lord our God has done to these two kings; thus the Lord our God shall do to all the kingdoms to which you are crossing over there;
verses.3:22: you shall not fear, for the Lord our God Himself fights for you."
verses.3:23: And I pleaded before the Lord at that time, saying,
verses.3:24: "O Lord God, You have begun to show Your servant Your strength and Your power, and Your mighty hand and Your uplifted arm; for what god is there in heaven or on earth who will do according to what You have done and according to Your strength?
verses.3:25: Let me cross over therefore and see this good land that is beyond the Jordan, the good mountain and Antilebanon."
verses.3:26: Yet the Lord disregarded me on account of you, and did not listen to me; and the Lord said to me, "Let it be enough for you; do not speak this word anymore.
verses.3:27: Go up to the summit of the Hewn Peak, and having lifted up your eyes toward the sea and the north and the south and the east, look with your eyes; for you shall not cross over this Jordan.
verses.3:28: And command Joshua, and strengthen him and encourage him; for he shall cross over before the face of this people, and he himself shall cause them to inherit the land which you have seen."
verses.3:29: And we dwelt in the valley near the house of Peor.
verses.4:1: And now, O Israel, listen to the statutes and the judgments, all that I teach you today to do, that you may live and be multiplied, and enter in and inherit the land which the Lord, the God of your fathers, gives to you.
verses.4:2: You shall not add to the word which I command you, nor shall you take away from it; keep the commandments of the Lord your God, all that I command you today.
verses.4:3: Your eyes have seen all that the Lord our God did to Baal-peor; for every man who went after Baal-peor, the Lord your God destroyed him from among us.
verses.4:4: But you who hold fast to the Lord your God are all alive on this day.
verses.4:5: See, I have shown you statutes and judgments, just as the Lord commanded me, to do thus in the land into which you are entering to inherit it.
verses.4:6: And you shall keep and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding before all the nations, as many as shall hear all these statutes and shall say, "Behold, this great nation is a wise and understanding people."
verses.4:7: For what great nation is there that has a god drawing near to them, as the Lord our God is in all things for which we call upon Him?
verses.4:8: And what great nation is there that has righteous statutes and judgments according to all this law which I give to you today?
verses.4:9: Take heed to yourself and diligently guard your soul, lest you forget all the things which your eyes have seen, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; and you shall instruct your sons and the sons of your sons—the day on which you stood before the Lord our God at Horeb on the day of the assembly, when
verses.4:10: the Lord said to me, "Assemble the people to Me, and let them hear My words, that they may learn to fear Me all the days that they live upon the earth, and they shall teach their sons."
verses.4:11: And you came near and stood beneath the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire up to heaven—darkness, gloom, tempest, a great voice.
verses.4:12: And the Lord spoke to you out of the midst of the fire a sound of words which you heard, and you saw no likeness, but only a voice.
verses.4:13: And He declared to you His covenant which He commanded you to perform, the ten words; and He wrote them upon two tablets of stone.
verses.4:14: And the Lord commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that you should do them in the land into which you are entering to inherit it.
verses.4:15: And you shall diligently guard your souls, for you saw no likeness on the day when the Lord spoke to you at Horeb on the mountain out of the midst of the fire,
verses.4:16: lest you act lawlessly and make for yourselves a carved likeness, any image, the likeness of male or female,
verses.4:17: the likeness of any beast of those that are upon the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies beneath heaven,
verses.4:18: the likeness of any creeping thing that creeps upon the earth, the likeness of any fish, of those that are in the waters beneath the earth;
verses.4:19: and lest, lifting up your eyes to heaven and seeing the sun and the moon and the stars and all the array of heaven, you be led astray and bow down to them and serve them, which the Lord your God has apportioned to all the nations that are beneath heaven.
verses.4:20: But God has taken you and brought us out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to Him a people of inheritance, as on this day.
verses.4:21: And the Lord was angry with me concerning the things spoken by you, and swore that I should not cross over this Jordan, and that I should not enter the land which the Lord your God gives to you as an inheritance.
verses.4:22: For I am dying in this land, and I am not crossing over the Jordan; but you are crossing over and shall inherit this good land.
verses.4:23: Take heed to yourselves, lest you forget the covenant of the Lord your God which He made with you, and make for yourselves a carved likeness of any of the things concerning which the Lord your God has given command;
verses.4:24: for the Lord your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.
verses.4:25: And if you have sons and the sons of your sons, and remain a long time upon the land, and act lawlessly and make a carved likeness of anything, and do evil things before the Lord
verses.4:26: your God, to provoke Him to anger, I call both heaven and earth to witness against you today that you shall utterly perish from the land into which you are crossing over the Jordan to inherit it; you shall not live many days upon it, but shall surely be utterly destroyed.
verses.4:27: And the Lord shall scatter you among all the nations, and you shall be left few in number among the nations into which the Lord shall lead you.
verses.4:28: And there you shall serve other gods, the works of men's hands, wood and stone, which shall neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
verses.4:29: And there you shall seek the Lord our God, and you shall find Him, whenever you seek Him out with all your heart and with all your soul in your affliction.
verses.4:30: And all these things shall find you at the end of the days, and you shall return to the Lord your God and heed His voice;
verses.4:31: for the Lord your God is a compassionate God; He will not forsake you nor destroy you, nor will He forget the covenant of your fathers which He swore to them.
verses.4:32: Inquire of the former days that were before you, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and from one end of heaven to the other end of heaven, whether anything has happened like this great thing, or whether such a thing has been heard of; whether any nation has heard the voice
verses.4:33: of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as you have heard, and lived;
verses.4:34: or whether God has attempted to go and take for Himself a nation from the midst of another nation, by trial, and by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by an uplifted arm, and by great visions, according to all that our God did in Egypt before your eyes as you watched—
verses.4:35: so that you might know that the Lord your God—He is God, and there is no other besides Him.
verses.4:36: Out of heaven His voice was made audible to instruct you, and upon the earth He showed you His great fire, and you heard His words out of the midst of the fire.
verses.4:37: Because He loved your fathers, He also chose their seed after them—even you—and He Himself brought you out of Egypt by His great strength,
verses.4:38: to utterly destroy nations great and stronger than you before your face, to bring you in, and to give you their land to inherit, as you have it today.
verses.4:39: And you shall know today, and consider in your mind, that the Lord your God—He is God in heaven above and upon the earth beneath, and there is no other besides Him.
verses.4:40: And keep His statutes and His commandments, all that I command you today, that it may be well with you and with your sons after you, and that you may live many days upon the land which the Lord your God gives to you all the days.
verses.4:41: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the rising of the sun,
verses.4:42: that the manslayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unwittingly, not having hated him before yesterday or before the third day; and he shall flee into one of these cities and live:
verses.4:43: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for Reuben; and Ramoth in Gilead for Gaddi; and Golan in Bashan for Manasseh.
verses.4:44: This is the law which Moses set before the sons of Israel;
verses.4:45: these are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments which Moses spoke to the sons of Israel when they had come out of the land of Egypt,
verses.4:46: beyond the Jordan, in the valley near the house of Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, whom Moses and the sons of Israel struck down when they had come out of the land of Egypt.
verses.4:47: And they inherited his land and the land of Gog king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan toward the rising of the sun,
verses.4:48: from Aroer, which is on the bank of the brook Arnon, even to Mount Sihon, which is Hermon,
verses.4:49: all the Arabah beyond the Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from Asedoth the hewn.
verses.5:1: And Moses summoned all Israel and said to them, "Hear, O Israel, the ordinances and the judgments, all that I speak in your ears on this day; and you shall learn them and take care to do them.
verses.5:2: The Lord your God established a covenant with you at Horeb.
verses.5:3: Not with your fathers did the Lord establish this covenant, but with you—you who are all here alive today.
verses.5:4: Face to face the Lord spoke to you on the mountain from the midst of the fire,
verses.5:5: and I stood between the Lord and you at that time to declare to you the words of the Lord, because you were afraid before the fire and did not go up into the mountain, saying,
verses.5:6: 'I am the Lord your God, who brought you forth from the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.5:7: You shall have no other gods before My face.
verses.5:8: You shall not make for yourself an idol, nor a likeness of anything that is in heaven above, and that is on the earth beneath, and that is in the waters underneath the earth.
verses.5:9: You shall not bow down to them, nor shall you serve them; for I am the Lord your God, a jealous God, repaying the sins of fathers upon children to the third and fourth generation of those who hate Me,
verses.5:10: and showing mercy to thousands, to those who love Me and to those who keep My decrees.
verses.5:11: You shall not take the name of the Lord your God in vain; for the Lord will by no means acquit the one who takes His name in vain.
verses.5:12: Guard the Sabbath day to sanctify it, in the manner that the Lord your God commanded you.
verses.5:13: Six days you shall labor and perform all your works,
verses.5:14: but on the seventh day is a Sabbath to the Lord your God. You shall not do any work on it: you, and your sons, and your daughter, your manservant and your maidservant, your ox and your beast of burden and all your livestock, the stranger who sojourns among you; for in six days the Lord made both heaven and earth and the sea and all that is in them; so that your manservant and your maidservant may rest, just as you also do.
verses.5:15: And you shall remember that you were a bondservant in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God brought you forth from there with a mighty hand and with an uplifted arm; therefore the Lord your God directed you to guard the Sabbath day and to sanctify it.
verses.5:16: Honor your father and your mother, in the manner that the Lord your God commanded, that it may be well with you, and that you may live long upon the land which the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.5:20: You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
verses.5:21: You shall not covet the wife of your neighbor; you shall not covet the house of your neighbor, nor his field, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his beast of burden, nor any of his livestock, nor anything that belongs to your neighbor.'
verses.5:22: These words the Lord spoke to all your congregation on the mountain from the midst of the fire—darkness, thick gloom, tempest, a great voice—and He added no more; and He wrote them upon two tablets and gave them to me.
verses.5:23: And it came to pass, when you heard the voice from the midst of the fire while the mountain was blazing with fire, that you drew near to me, all the leaders of your tribes and your council of elders;
verses.5:24: and you said, 'Behold, the Lord our God has shown His glory, and we have heard His voice from the midst of the fire; on this day we have seen that God will speak to man, and he shall live.
verses.5:25: And now let us not die, for this great fire will utterly consume us; if we continue to hear the voice of the Lord our God any longer, then we shall die.
verses.5:26: For what flesh is there that has heard the voice of the living God speaking from the midst of the fire, as we have, and shall live?
verses.5:27: You draw near and hear all that the Lord our God may say; and you shall speak to us everything that the Lord our God speaks to you, and we will hear and do it.'
verses.5:28: And the Lord heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me, and the Lord said to me, 'I have heard the voice of the words of this people, all that they have spoken to you; all that they have spoken is right.
verses.5:29: Who will grant that their heart might be thus within them, so as to fear Me and to keep My commandments all the days, that it may be well with them and with their sons forever?
verses.5:30: Go, say to them, "Return to your houses."
verses.5:31: But as for you, stand here with Me, and I will speak to you the commandments, the ordinances, and the judgments which you shall teach them; and let them perform them in the land which I am giving them as an inheritance.'
verses.5:32: And you shall take care to do in the manner that the Lord your God commanded you; you shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left,
verses.5:33: according to all the way which the Lord your God commanded you to walk in, so that He may give you rest, and it may be well with you, and you may prolong your days upon the land which you shall inherit."
verses.6:1: Now these are the commandments, the ordinances, and the judgments which our God commanded to teach you, that you may do thus in the land into which you are entering to inherit it,
verses.6:2: that you may fear the Lord your God; guard all His ordinances and His commandments which I command you today—you, and your sons, and the sons of your sons—all the days of your life, that you may prolong your days.
verses.6:3: And hear, O Israel, and take care to perform them, so that it may be well with you, and that you may be greatly multiplied, just as the Lord, the God of your fathers, spoke to give you a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.6:4: And these are the ordinances and the judgments which the Lord commanded the sons of Israel when they went forth from the land of Egypt: Hear, O Israel: the Lord our God is one Lord;
verses.6:5: and you shall love the Lord your God with all your mind, and with all your soul, and with all your might.
verses.6:6: And these words which I command you today shall be in your heart and in your soul;
verses.6:7: and you shall diligently instruct your sons, and you shall speak of them when sitting in the house, and when walking on the way, and when lying down, and when rising up.
verses.6:8: And you shall fasten them as a sign upon your hand, and it shall be immovable before your eyes;
verses.6:9: and you shall write them upon the doorposts of your houses and of your gates.
verses.6:10: And it shall come to pass, when the Lord your God brings you into the land which the Lord swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give you—great and fair cities which you did not build,
verses.6:11: houses full of all good things which you did not fill, hewn cisterns which you did not hew out, vineyards and olive groves which you did not plant—and when you have eaten and are filled, take heed to yourself lest you forget
verses.6:12: the Lord your God, who brought you forth from the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.6:13: The Lord your God you shall fear, and Him you shall serve, and to Him you shall cling, and by His name you shall swear.
verses.6:14: You shall not walk after other gods from among the nations that are all around you,
verses.6:15: for the Lord your God in your midst is a jealous God—lest the Lord your God be provoked to wrath against you and utterly destroy you from the face of the earth.
verses.6:16: You shall not test the Lord your God, as you tested Him at Testing.
verses.6:17: You shall diligently guard the commandments of the Lord your God, the testimonies and the ordinances which He commanded you;
verses.6:18: and you shall do what is pleasing and good before the Lord your God, that it may be well with you, and that you may enter and inherit the good land which the Lord swore to your fathers,
verses.6:19: to drive out all your enemies from before your face, just as the Lord has spoken.
verses.6:20: And it shall come to pass, when your son asks you in days to come, saying, "What are the testimonies, the ordinances, and the judgments which the Lord our God has commanded us?"
verses.6:21: then you shall say to your son, "We were bondservants to Pharaoh in the land of Egypt, and the Lord brought us forth from there with a mighty hand and with an uplifted arm;
verses.6:22: and the Lord gave signs and wonders, great and grievous, in Egypt, upon Pharaoh and upon his house, in our sight;
verses.6:23: and He brought us forth from there to give us this land which He swore to give to our fathers.
verses.6:24: And the Lord commanded us to perform all these ordinances, to fear the Lord our God, that it may be well with us all the days, that we may live, just as we do today;
verses.6:25: and there shall be mercy for us if we take care to perform all these commandments before the Lord our God, just as the Lord has commanded us."
verses.7:1: Now when the Lord your God brings you into the land where you are entering to inherit it, and casts out great nations from before your face, the Hittite and the Amorite and the Girgashite and the Canaanite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite, seven nations numerous and mightier than you,
verses.7:2: and the Lord your God delivers them into your hands and you strike them, you shall utterly destroy them; you shall not make a covenant with them, nor shall you show mercy to them,
verses.7:3: nor shall you intermarry with them; you shall not give your daughter to his son, and you shall not take his daughter for your son;
verses.7:4: for he will turn your son away from Me, and he will serve other gods; and the Lord will be angry with wrath against you, and He will swiftly destroy you.
verses.7:5: But thus you shall do to them: you shall tear down their altars, and shatter their pillars, and cut down their groves, and burn the graven images of their gods with fire.
verses.7:6: For you are a holy people to the Lord your God, and the Lord your God has chosen you to be to Him a treasured people above all the nations that are upon the face of the earth.
verses.7:7: It is not because you are more numerous than all the nations that the Lord preferred you and chose you, for you are the fewest among all the nations;
verses.7:8: but because the Lord loves you, and because He keeps the oath which He swore to your fathers, the Lord brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
verses.7:9: And you shall know today that the Lord your God—He is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and mercy for those who love Him and for those who keep His commandments to a thousand generations,
verses.7:10: and who repays those who hate Him to their face, to destroy them; and He will not delay toward those who hate Him; to their face He will repay them.
verses.7:11: And you shall keep His commandments and His statutes and His judgments, all that I command you today to do.
verses.7:12: And it shall come to pass, if you listen to these statutes and keep and do them, that the Lord your God will preserve for you the covenant and the mercy which He swore to your fathers;
verses.7:13: and the Lord will love you and bless you and multiply you; and He will bless the offspring of your womb and the fruit of your land—your grain and your wine and your oil, the herds of your cattle and the flocks of your sheep—upon the land, as the Lord swore to your fathers to give to you.
verses.7:14: You shall be blessed above all the nations; there shall not be among you any who is sterile or barren, nor among your livestock.
verses.7:15: And the Lord will take away from you every infirmity; and all the evil diseases of Egypt which you have seen and all that you have known, He will not lay upon you, but He will lay them upon all who hate you.
verses.7:16: And you shall consume all the spoils of the nations which the Lord your God gives to you; your eye shall not spare them, and you shall not serve their gods, for that is a stumbling block to you.
verses.7:17: Now if you say in your mind, "This nation is more numerous than I; how shall I be able to destroy them?"
verses.7:18: you shall not fear them; you shall surely remember all that the Lord your God did to Pharaoh and to all the Egyptians:
verses.7:19: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs and the wonders, the mighty hand and the uplifted arm, as the Lord your God brought you out; so shall the Lord our God do to all the nations before whose face you are afraid.
verses.7:20: Moreover, the Lord your God will send the hornets among them, until those who remain and those who are hidden from you are wiped out.
verses.7:21: You shall not be wounded before their face, for the Lord your God is among you, a great and mighty God.
verses.7:22: And the Lord your God will consume these nations from before your face little by little; you will not be able to utterly consume them swiftly, lest the land become desolate and the wild beasts multiply against you.
verses.7:23: And the Lord your God will deliver them into your hands, and you shall destroy them with a great destruction until He utterly destroys them;
verses.7:24: and He will deliver their kings into your hands, and their name shall perish from their place; no one shall stand before your face, until He utterly destroys them.
verses.7:25: The graven images of their gods you shall burn in fire; you shall not covet silver and gold from them, nor take it for yourself, lest you stumble because of it, for it is an abomination to the Lord your God;
verses.7:26: and you shall not bring an abomination into your house, and become an accursed thing like it; you shall utterly abhor it and utterly detest it, for it is an accursed thing.
verses.8:1: All the commandments which I command you today you shall take care to do, that you may live and be multiplied, and go in and inherit the land which the Lord your God swore to your fathers.
verses.8:2: And you shall remember all the way which the Lord your God led you in the wilderness, so that He might afflict you and test you, and that what was in your heart might be discerned, whether you would keep His commandments or not.
verses.8:3: And He afflicted you and caused you to hunger, and fed you with the manna which your fathers did not know, that He might declare to you that man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds through the mouth of God shall man live.
verses.8:4: Your garments did not grow old upon you, your sandals did not wear out upon you, your feet did not become calloused—behold, forty years.
verses.8:5: And you shall know in your heart that just as a man disciplines his son, so the Lord your God will discipline you;
verses.8:6: and you shall keep the commandments of the Lord your God, to walk in His ways and to fear Him.
verses.8:7: For the Lord your God is bringing you into a good and vast land, where there are brooks of water, springs of the deeps issuing forth through the plains and through the mountains;
verses.8:8: a land of wheat and barley, vines, fig trees, pomegranates, a land of olive oil and honey;
verses.8:9: a land in which you shall not eat your bread in poverty, and you shall lack nothing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose mountains you shall mine bronze.
verses.8:10: And you shall eat and be filled, and you shall bless the Lord your God for the good land which He has given to you.
verses.8:11: Take heed to yourself lest you forget the Lord your God, so as not to keep His commandments and judgments and His statutes, all that I command you today;
verses.8:12: lest, when you have eaten and are filled, and have built fine houses and dwell in them,
verses.8:13: and when your cattle are multiplied and your sheep are multiplied, and silver and gold are multiplied to you, and all that you shall have is multiplied to you,
verses.8:14: you be lifted up in your heart and forget the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;
verses.8:15: who led you through that great and fearful wilderness, where there was the biting serpent and scorpion and thirst, where there was no water; who brought forth for you from the flinty rock a spring of water;
verses.8:16: who fed you with the manna in the wilderness, which your fathers did not know, that He might afflict you and test you, and do you good at the end of your days.
verses.8:17: Do not say in your heart, "My strength and the might of my hand have produced for me this great wealth."
verses.8:18: And you shall remember the Lord your God, for it is He who gives you the strength to produce wealth, and that He may establish the covenant which the Lord swore to your fathers, as it is today.
verses.8:19: And it shall come to pass, if you utterly forget the Lord your God, and go after other gods and serve them, I solemnly testify to you today that you shall surely perish;
verses.8:20: just as the rest of the nations which the Lord destroys before your face, so shall you perish, because you did not listen to the voice of the Lord your God.
verses.9:1: Hear, O Israel: you are crossing over this Jordan today to go in to inherit nations great and much stronger than you, great cities walled up to heaven,
verses.9:2: a great and numerous and tall people, the sons of Anak, whom you know, and you have heard, "Who can stand before the face of the sons of Anak?"
verses.9:3: And you shall know today that the Lord your God—He goes before your face; He is a consuming fire. He shall utterly destroy them, and He shall turn them back from before your face, and you shall destroy them, just as the Lord spoke to you.
verses.9:4: Do not say in your heart, when the Lord your God has consumed these nations from before you, saying, "Because of my righteousness the Lord has brought me in to inherit this good land."
verses.9:5: It is not because of your righteousness nor because of the holiness of your heart that you are going in to inherit their land, but because of the ungodliness of these nations the Lord will utterly destroy them from before your face, and that He may establish His covenant which He swore to your fathers, to Abraham and to Isaac and to Jacob.
verses.9:6: And you shall know today that it is not because of your righteous deeds that the Lord your God gives you this good land to inherit, for you are a stiff-necked people.
verses.9:7: Remember, do not forget how much you provoked the Lord your God in the wilderness; from the day you went out from Egypt and came to this place, you have continually been disobedient toward the Lord.
verses.9:8: Also at Horeb you provoked the Lord, and He was filled with wrath against you to destroy you utterly,
verses.9:9: when I went up into the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant which the Lord made with you. And I remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights; I did not eat bread, and I did not drink water.
verses.9:10: And the Lord gave to me the two tablets of stone, written by the finger of God, and upon them had been written all the words which the Lord spoke to you on the mountain in the day of the assembly.
verses.9:11: And it came to pass after forty days and forty nights that the Lord gave to me the two tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant.
verses.9:12: And the Lord spoke to me, "Arise, go down quickly from here, for your people whom you brought out of the land of Egypt have acted lawlessly; they have quickly transgressed from the way which you commanded them, and have made for themselves a molten image."
verses.9:13: And the Lord spoke to me, "I have spoken to you once and twice, saying, 'I have seen this people, and behold, it is a stiff-necked people';
verses.9:14: and now let Me alone that I may utterly destroy them, and I will blot out their name from under heaven, and I will make you into a nation great and strong and far more numerous than this."
verses.9:15: And I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire up to heaven, and the two tablets were in my two hands.
verses.9:16: And when I saw that you had sinned before the Lord your God, and had made for yourselves a molten image, and had transgressed from the way which the Lord commanded you,
verses.9:17: then I took hold of the two tablets and cast them out of my two hands, and shattered them before you.
verses.9:18: And I made supplication before the Lord a second time, just as at the first, forty days and forty nights; I did not eat bread and I did not drink water, because of all your sins which you had sinned, in doing evil before the Lord God to provoke Him.
verses.9:19: And I am terrified because of the wrath and the fury, for the Lord was provoked against you to destroy you utterly; yet the Lord listened to me at this time also.
verses.9:20: And against Aaron He was filled with wrath to destroy him utterly, and I prayed for Aaron also at that time.
verses.9:21: And your sin which you had made, the calf, I took it and burned it completely in fire, and broke it in pieces, grinding it thoroughly until it became fine; and it became like dust, and I cast the dust into the brook that came down from the mountain.
verses.9:22: Also at the Burning, and at the Testing, and at the Graves of Craving, you were provoking the Lord.
verses.9:23: And when the Lord sent you out from Kadesh Barnea, saying, "Go up and inherit the land which I give to you," then you disobeyed the word of the Lord your God, and you did not believe Him, and you did not listen to His voice.
verses.9:24: You have been disobedient toward the Lord from the day He became known to you.
verses.9:25: And I made supplication before the Lord forty days and forty nights, as long as I made supplication, for the Lord had spoken to destroy you utterly.
verses.9:26: And I prayed to God and said, "O Lord, King of the gods, do not utterly destroy Your people and Your portion whom You have redeemed, whom You brought out of the land of Egypt with Your great strength, and with Your mighty hand, and with Your uplifted arm.
verses.9:27: Remember Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, Your servants, to whom You swore by Yourself; do not look upon the hardness of this people, nor their ungodly deeds, nor their sins,
verses.9:28: lest those who dwell in the land from which You brought us out speak, saying, 'Because the Lord was not able to bring them into the land of which He spoke to them, and because He hated them, He brought them out into the wilderness to slay them.'
verses.9:29: Yet these are Your people and Your inheritance, whom You brought out of the land of Egypt with Your great strength, and with Your mighty hand, and with Your uplifted arm."
verses.10:1: At that time the Lord spoke to me, "Hew for yourself two tablets of stone like the first, and come up to Me on the mountain, and you shall make for yourself an ark of wood;
verses.10:2: and you shall write on the tablets the words which were on the first tablets which you shattered, and you shall put them into the ark."
verses.10:3: So I made an ark of incorruptible wood, and hewed the tablets of stone like the first, and went up into the mountain, and the two tablets were in my hands.
verses.10:4: And He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten words which the Lord spoke to you on the mountain out of the midst of the fire; and the Lord gave them to me.
verses.10:5: Then I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets into the ark which I had made; and they were there, just as the Lord commanded me.
verses.10:6: And the sons of Israel departed from Beeroth of the sons of Jakim to Misadai; there Aaron died, and there he was buried, and Eleazar his son served as priest in his place.
verses.10:7: From there they departed to Gadgad, and from Gadgad to Taibatha, a land of brooks of water.
verses.10:8: At that time the Lord set apart the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of the covenant of the Lord, to stand before the Lord, to minister and to invoke blessings in His name, until this day.
verses.10:9: Therefore the Levites have no portion and inheritance among their brethren; the Lord Himself is his inheritance, just as He spoke to him.
verses.10:10: And I stood on the mountain forty days and forty nights, and the Lord heard me at this time also, and the Lord was not willing to destroy you utterly.
verses.10:11: And the Lord spoke to me, "Go, depart before this people, and let them go in and inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them."
verses.10:12: And now, O Israel, what does the Lord your God ask of you, except to fear the Lord your God, and to walk in all His ways, and to love Him, and to serve the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.10:13: to keep the commandments of the Lord your God and His ordinances, all that I command you today, that it may be well with you?
verses.10:14: Behold, to the Lord your God belong heaven and the heaven of heaven, the earth and all things that are in it.
verses.10:15: Yet the Lord preferred your fathers, to love them, and He chose their seed after them—even you—above all the nations, as it is this day.
verses.10:16: And you shall circumcise the hardness of your heart, and you shall not stiffen your neck.
verses.10:17: For the Lord your God—He is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great and mighty and awesome God, who does not show partiality, nor will He by any means take a bribe;
verses.10:18: executing justice for the sojourner and the orphan and the widow, and He loves the sojourner, giving him bread and clothing.
verses.10:19: And you shall love the sojourner, for you were sojourners in the land of Egypt.
verses.10:20: You shall fear the Lord your God, and Him you shall serve, and to Him you shall cling, and by His name you shall swear.
verses.10:21: He is your boast, and He is your God, who has done among you these great and glorious things which your eyes have seen.
verses.10:22: With seventy souls your fathers went down to Egypt, but now the Lord your God has made you like the stars of heaven in multitude.
verses.11:1: And you shall love the Lord your God, and keep His charges, and His statutes, and His judgments all the days.
verses.11:2: And you shall know today that it is not your children, who have neither known nor seen the discipline of the Lord your God, and His great deeds, and His mighty hand, and His uplifted arm,
verses.11:3: and His signs and His wonders which He did in the midst of Egypt to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to all his land,
verses.11:4: and what He did to the army of the Egyptians, their chariots and their horses and their force, how He flooded the water of the Red Sea over their face as they pursued after you, and the Lord destroyed them even to this day,
verses.11:5: and what He did for us in the wilderness until you came to this place,
verses.11:6: and what He did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab the son of Reuben, whom the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up, together with their households and their tents and all their substance that was with them, in the midst of all Israel;
verses.11:7: for your eyes have seen all the works of the Lord which He has done for you today.
verses.11:8: And you shall keep all His commandments which I command you today, that you may live and be multiplied, and go in and inherit the land into which you are crossing over the Jordan to inherit it;
verses.11:9: that you may prolong your days upon the land which the Lord swore to your fathers to give to them and to their seed after them, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.11:10: For the land into which you are entering to inherit it is not like the land of Egypt, from which you came out, when they sow the seed and water it with their feet like a garden of herbs;
verses.11:11: but the land into which you are entering to inherit it is a land of mountains and plains; it shall drink water from the rain of heaven;
verses.11:12: a land which the Lord your God watches over continually; the eyes of the Lord your God are upon it from the beginning of the year even to the end of the year.
verses.11:13: And if you diligently heed all the commandments which I command you today, to love the Lord your God and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.11:14: then He will give the rain for your land in its season, both the early and the latter rain, and you shall gather in your grain, and your wine, and your oil;
verses.11:15: and He will give grass in your fields for your livestock. And when you have eaten and are satisfied,
verses.11:16: take heed to yourself, lest your heart be enlarged, and you transgress and serve other gods and worship them;
verses.11:17: and the Lord be provoked to wrath against you and shut up the heaven, so that there is no rain and the earth does not yield its fruit, and you perish swiftly from the good land which the Lord has given you.
verses.11:18: And you shall lay these words in your heart and in your soul, and you shall bind them as a sign upon your hand, and it shall be unmoved before your eyes;
verses.11:19: and you shall teach them to your children, speaking of them when you sit in your house and when you walk by the way, when you lie down and when you rise up;
verses.11:20: and you shall write them upon the doorposts of your houses and upon your gates,
verses.11:21: that you may prolong your days, and the days of your sons, upon the land which the Lord swore to your fathers to give to them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.
verses.11:22: And it shall come to pass, if you diligently heed all these commandments which I command you today to do them—to love the Lord our God, and to walk in all His ways, and to cleave to Him—
verses.11:23: then the Lord will cast out all these nations from before your face, and you shall inherit nations greater and stronger than yourselves.
verses.11:24: Every place where the sole of your foot shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness and Antilebanon, and from the great river, the river Euphrates, even to the western sea shall your borders be.
verses.11:25: No man shall stand before your face; the Lord your God shall put the dread of you and the fear of you upon the face of all the land on which you tread, just as He spoke to you.
verses.11:26: Behold, I set before you today the blessing and the curse:
verses.11:27: the blessing, if you heed the commandments of the Lord your God which I command you today;
verses.11:28: and the curses, if you do not heed the commandments of the Lord your God, all that I command you today, and wander astray from the way which I have commanded you, going to serve other gods whom you do not know.
verses.11:29: And it shall be, when the Lord your God brings you into the land into which you are crossing over to inherit it, that you shall put a blessing upon Mount Gerizim and the curse upon Mount Ebal.
verses.11:30: Behold, are they not beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the setting sun, in the land of Canaan, which dwells toward the west, beside Gilgal, near the lofty oak?
verses.11:31: For you are crossing over the Jordan, going in to inherit the land which the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance all the days, and you shall dwell in it.
verses.11:32: And you shall be careful to do all His ordinances and these judgments which I set before you today.
verses.12:1: And these are the ordinances and the judgments which you shall be careful to do in the land which the Lord, the God of our fathers, is giving you as an inheritance, all the days that you live upon the earth.
verses.12:2: You shall utterly destroy all the places where those whom you are dispossessing served their gods, upon the high mountains and upon the hills and beneath a leafy tree;
verses.12:3: and you shall tear down their altars, and shatter their pillars, and cut down their groves, and burn the carved images of their gods with fire; and their name shall perish from that place.
verses.12:4: You shall not do thus to the Lord your God;
verses.12:5: but to the place which the Lord your God shall choose in one of your cities, to name His name there to be called upon, even there you shall seek;
verses.12:6: and you shall bring your burnt offerings, and your freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your herds and of your flocks;
verses.12:7: and there you shall eat before the Lord your God, and you shall rejoice in all to which you put your hand, you and your households, according as the Lord your God has blessed you.
verses.12:8: You shall not do all the things which we are doing here today, every man doing what is pleasing in his own sight;
verses.12:9: for as yet you have not come to the rest and to the inheritance which the Lord our God is giving you.
verses.12:10: And you shall cross over the Jordan and dwell in the land which the Lord our God gives you to inherit, and He shall give you rest from all your enemies round about, and you shall dwell in safety.
verses.12:11: Then there shall be the place which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there; you shall bring all that I command you today: your burnt offerings and your sacrifices, your tithes and the firstfruits of your hands, and every choice thing of your gifts, whatever you vow to God;
verses.12:12: and you shall rejoice before the Lord your God, you and your sons and your daughters, your menservants and your maidservants, and the Levite who is at your gates, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you.
verses.12:13: Take heed to yourself lest you offer up your burnt offerings in every place that you see;
verses.12:14: but rather in the place which the Lord your God shall choose in one of your tribes, there you shall offer up your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I command you today.
verses.12:15: Yet according to all your desire you may slaughter and eat meat, according to the blessing of the Lord your God which He has given you in every city; the unclean among you and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle or the deer;
verses.12:16: only you shall not eat the blood; you shall pour it out upon the earth like water.
verses.12:17: You may not eat within your cities the tithe of your grain, and of your wine, and of your oil, nor the firstborn of your herds, nor any vows which you vow, nor your freewill offerings, nor the firstfruits of your hands;
verses.12:18: but you shall eat it before the Lord your God in the place which the Lord your God shall choose for Himself, you and your son and your daughter, your manservant and your maidservant, and the sojourner who is in your cities; and you shall rejoice before the Lord your God in all to which you put your hand.
verses.12:19: Take heed to yourself lest you forsake the Levite all the time that you live upon the land.
verses.12:20: And if the Lord your God enlarges your borders, just as He spoke to you, and you say, "I will eat meat," if your soul desires to eat meat, according to all the desire of your soul you may eat meat.
verses.12:21: And if the place which the Lord your God chooses for His name to be called upon there is far from you, then you shall slaughter from your herds and from your flocks which God gives you, in the manner that I have commanded you, and you shall eat within your cities according to the desire of your soul;
verses.12:22: just as the gazelle and the deer are eaten, so you shall eat it; the unclean among you and the clean shall eat alike.
verses.12:23: Take earnest heed not to eat blood, for its blood is the life; the life shall not be eaten with the meat;
verses.12:24: you shall not eat it; you shall pour it out upon the earth like water;
verses.12:25: you shall not eat it, that it may be well with you and with your sons after you, if you do what is good and pleasing before the Lord your God.
verses.12:26: Only your holy things, if you have any, and your vows you shall take and come to the place which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there;
verses.12:27: and you shall offer your burnt offerings; and the meat you shall eat.
verses.12:28: Be watchful and listen, and you shall do all the words which I command you, that it may be well with you and with your sons forever, if you do what is good and pleasing before the Lord your God.
verses.12:29: And when the Lord your God utterly destroys from before your face the nations among whom you are entering to inherit their land, and you inherit it and dwell in their land,
verses.12:30: take heed to yourself lest you seek to follow after them after they have been utterly destroyed from before your face, saying, "How do these nations act toward their gods? I also will do so."
verses.12:31: You shall not do thus to your God; for the abominations of the Lord, which He hates, they have done with their gods; for their sons and their daughters they burn in fire to their gods.
verses.13:1: Every word that I command you today, this you shall take care to do; you shall not add to it, nor take away from it.
verses.13:2: And if there arises among you a prophet or one who dreams a dream, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,
verses.13:3: and the sign or the wonder comes to pass of which he spoke to you, saying, "Let us go and serve other gods," whom you do not know,
verses.13:4: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet or of the one who dreams that dream; for the Lord your God is testing you, to know whether you love your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.13:5: Walk after the Lord your God, and Him you shall fear, and to His voice you shall listen, and to Him you shall hold fast.
verses.13:6: And that prophet or that dreamer of the dream shall die; for he spoke to lead you astray from the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, who redeemed you from bondage, to thrust you out from the way in which the Lord your God commanded you to walk; and you shall purge the wicked person from among yourselves.
verses.13:7: And if your brother by your father or by your mother, or your son or your daughter, or the wife in your bosom, or a friend who is equal to your own soul, urges you, saying secretly, "Let us go and serve other gods," whom neither you nor your fathers have known,
verses.13:8: from among the gods of the nations that are all around you, those near to you or those far off from you, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth,
verses.13:9: you shall not consent to him, nor listen to him; neither shall your eye spare him, nor shall you yearn over him, nor shall you conceal him.
verses.13:10: You shall surely report concerning him; your hands shall be upon him first to put him to death, and the hands of all the people afterward.
verses.13:11: And they shall stone him with stones, and he shall die, because he sought to turn you away from the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.13:12: And all Israel shall hear and fear, and shall no longer continue to do according to this wicked thing among you.
verses.13:13: And if you hear in one of your cities, which the Lord your God gives you to dwell there, people saying,
verses.13:14: "Lawless men have gone out from among you and have turned away all who dwell in their land, saying, 'Let us go and serve other gods,' whom you have not known,"
verses.13:15: then you shall inquire and search out diligently; and behold, if the matter is truly clear and this abomination has been committed among you,
verses.13:16: you shall surely slay all who dwell in that land with the slaughter of the sword; you shall utterly devote it and all that is in it to destruction.
verses.13:17: And all its plunder you shall gather into its streets, and you shall burn the city with fire and all its plunder completely before the Lord your God; and it shall be uninhabited forever; it shall not be rebuilt again.
verses.13:18: And nothing of the devoted thing shall cling to your hand, that the Lord may turn from the fierceness of His wrath, and He will show you mercy and have compassion on you and multiply you, just as He swore to your fathers,
verses.13:19: if you listen to the voice of the Lord your God, to keep His commandments which I command you today, to do what is pleasing and good before the Lord your God.
verses.14:1: You are sons of the Lord your God; you shall not make a baldness between your eyes for the dead.
verses.14:2: For you are a holy people to the Lord your God, and the Lord your God has chosen you to be a treasured people for Himself from all the nations that are on the face of the earth.
verses.14:3: You shall not eat any abominable thing.
verses.14:4: These are the beasts that you shall eat: the calf from the cattle, and the lamb from the sheep, and the kid from the goats,
verses.14:5: the deer and the gazelle and the pygarg, the oryx and the giraffe;
verses.14:6: every beast that parts the hoof and divides the hoof into two claws, and brings up the cud among the beasts—these you shall eat.
verses.14:7: Yet these you shall not eat of those that bring up the cud and of those that part the hooves and divide the cloven hoof: the camel, and the hare, and the rock hyrax; for they bring up the cud, yet do not part the hoof; they are unclean for you.
verses.14:8: And the swine, because it parts the hoof and divides the cloven hoof, yet does not chew the cud, it is unclean for you; of their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcasses you shall not touch.
verses.14:9: And these you shall eat of all that are in the water: all that have fins and scales you shall eat.
verses.14:10: And all that do not have fins and scales you shall not eat; they are unclean for you.
verses.14:11: Every clean bird you shall eat.
verses.14:12: But these of them you shall not eat: the eagle, and the bearded vulture, and the sea eagle,
verses.14:13: and the vulture, and the kite and those like it,
verses.14:15: and the ostrich, and the owl, and the gull,
verses.14:16: and the heron, and the swan, and the ibis,
verses.14:17: and the cormorant, and the hawk and those like it, and the hoopoe, and the night raven,
verses.14:18: and the pelican, and the plover and those like it, and the purple gallinule, and the bat.
verses.14:19: All winged creeping things are unclean for you; you shall not eat of them.
verses.14:20: Every clean winged creature you shall eat.
verses.14:21: You shall not eat any carcass; it shall be given to the sojourner who is in your cities, and he shall eat it, or you shall sell it to a foreigner; for you are a holy people to the Lord your God. You shall not boil a lamb in its mother's milk.
verses.14:22: You shall surely tithe a tenth of all the produce of your seed, the produce of your field, year by year.
verses.14:23: And you shall eat it in the place which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there; you shall bring the tithes of your grain and of your wine and of your oil, and the firstborn of your cattle and of your sheep, that you may learn to fear the Lord your God all the days.
verses.14:24: And if the way is too far from you, so that you are not able to carry them up, because the place is far from you which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there, because the Lord your God will bless you,
verses.14:25: then you shall sell them for silver, and take the silver in your hands, and go to the place which the Lord your God shall choose;
verses.14:26: and you shall spend silver for whatever your soul desires; and you shall eat there before the Lord your God, and you shall rejoice, you and your son,
verses.14:27: and the Levite who is in your cities, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you.
verses.14:28: After three years you shall bring out all the tithe of your produce. In that year you shall deposit it in your cities.
verses.14:29: And the Levite shall come—because he has no portion nor inheritance with you—and the stranger, and the orphan, and the widow who is in your cities, and they shall eat and be filled, that the Lord your God may bless you in all the works that you do.
verses.15:1: Every seven years you shall make a release.
verses.15:2: And this is the ordinance of the release: you shall remit every personal debt that your neighbor owes you, and you shall not exact it of your brother, for the release has been proclaimed to the Lord your God.
verses.15:3: Of a foreigner you shall exact whatever of yours is with him, but for your brother you shall grant a release of your debt;
verses.15:4: for there shall be no needy person among you, because the Lord your God will surely bless you in the land which the Lord your God gives you as an inheritance to possess it,
verses.15:5: if indeed you diligently listen to the voice of the Lord your God, to keep and to do all these commandments that I command you today.
verses.15:6: For the Lord your God has blessed you just as He spoke to you; and you shall lend to many nations, but you shall not borrow; and you shall rule over many nations, but they shall not rule over you.
verses.15:7: And if there is among you a needy one of your brethren in one of your cities in the land which the Lord your God gives you, you shall not turn away your heart, nor shall you tightly shut your hand from your needy brother;
verses.15:8: you shall surely open your hands to him, and shall surely lend him a loan as much as he needs, according to what he lacks.
verses.15:9: Take heed to yourself lest there be a hidden thought in your heart, a lawless thing, saying, "The seventh year, the year of release, is drawing near," and your eye be evil toward your needy brother, and you do not give to him, and he cries out against you to the Lord, and it becomes a great sin in you.
verses.15:10: You shall surely give to him, and you shall surely lend him a loan as much as he needs, according to what he lacks; and you shall not be grieved in your heart when you give to him, because for this matter the Lord your God will bless you in all the works and in all to which you set your hand.
verses.15:11: For a needy person shall never cease from the land; therefore I command you to do this thing, saying, "You shall surely open your hands to your brother, to the poor and to the needy who is in your land."
verses.15:12: And if your brother, a Hebrew man or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you, he shall serve you six years, and in the seventh you shall send him out free from you.
verses.15:13: And when you send him out free from you, you shall not send him out empty-handed;
verses.15:14: you shall generously supply him with provisions from your sheep, and from your grain, and from your wine; just as the Lord your God has blessed you, you shall give to him.
verses.15:15: And you shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God redeemed you from there; therefore I command you to do this thing.
verses.15:16: And if he says to you, "I will not go out from you," because he has loved you and your house, because it is well with him beside you,
verses.15:17: then you shall take the awl and pierce his ear against the door, and he shall be your servant forever; and to your maidservant you shall do likewise.
verses.15:18: It shall not seem hard in your sight when they are sent out free from you, for he has served you six years for the yearly wage of a hired servant; and the Lord your God will bless you in all that you do.
verses.15:19: Every firstborn that is born among your cattle and among your sheep—the males—you shall sanctify to the Lord your God; you shall not work with your firstborn calf, nor shall you shear the firstborn of your sheep.
verses.15:20: Before the Lord you shall eat it year by year in the place which the Lord your God shall choose, you and your household.
verses.15:21: And if there is a blemish in it, lame or blind, an evil blemish, you shall not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
verses.15:22: Within your cities you shall eat it; the unclean among you and the clean alike shall eat it, as a gazelle or a deer.
verses.15:23: Only you shall not eat blood; upon the earth you shall pour it out as water.
verses.16:1: Observe the month of new fruits, and you shall keep the Passover to the Lord your God; for in the month of new fruits you came out of Egypt by night.
verses.16:2: And you shall sacrifice the Passover to the Lord your God, sheep and oxen, in the place that the Lord your God chooses for His name to be called upon there.
verses.16:3: You shall eat no leaven with it; seven days you shall eat unleavened bread with it, the bread of affliction, for you came out of Egypt in haste, that you may remember the day of your departure from the land of Egypt all the days of your life.
verses.16:4: No leaven shall be seen with you within all your borders for seven days, nor shall any of the flesh that you sacrifice in the evening on the first day remain overnight until the morning.
verses.16:5: You may not sacrifice the Passover in any of your cities that the Lord your God gives you,
verses.16:6: but only in the place that the Lord your God chooses for His name to be called upon there; you shall sacrifice the Passover in the evening, at the setting of the sun, at the season when you came out of Egypt.
verses.16:7: And you shall boil and roast and eat it in the place that the Lord your God chooses; and in the morning you shall turn back and go to your houses.
verses.16:8: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day shall be a concluding assembly, a feast to the Lord your God; you shall do no work on it, except whatever shall be done for a soul.
verses.16:9: Seven weeks you shall count off for yourself; from the time you begin to put the sickle to the harvest, you shall begin to count off seven weeks.
verses.16:10: And you shall keep the Feast of Weeks to the Lord your God according as your hand is able, according to all that the Lord your God gives.
verses.16:11: And you shall rejoice before your God, both your son and your daughter, your manservant and your maidservant, and the Levite, and the sojourner, and the orphan, and the widow who is among you, in the place that the Lord your God chooses for His name to be called upon there.
verses.16:12: And you shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and you shall observe and do these commandments.
verses.16:13: You shall keep the Feast of Tabernacles for yourself seven days, when you gather in from your threshing floor and from your winepress.
verses.16:14: And you shall rejoice in your feast, you and your son and your daughter, your manservant and your maidservant, and the Levite, and the sojourner, and the orphan, and the widow who is in your cities.
verses.16:15: Seven days you shall keep the feast to the Lord your God in the place that the Lord your God chooses for Himself; and if the Lord your God blesses you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands, then you shall be joyful.
verses.16:16: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord your God in the place that the Lord chooses: at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, and at the Feast of Weeks, and at the Feast of Tabernacles. You shall not appear before the Lord your God empty-handed;
verses.16:17: every man according to the ability of your hands, according to the blessing of the Lord your God which He has given you.
verses.16:18: You shall appoint judges and recorders for yourself in your cities that the Lord your God gives you, tribe by tribe, and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.
verses.16:19: They shall not show partiality, nor shall they accept a bribe; for bribes blind the eyes of the wise and overturn the words of the righteous.
verses.16:20: Justly you shall pursue what is just, that you may live and enter in and inherit the land which the Lord your God gives you.
verses.16:21: You shall not plant a sacred grove for yourself; you shall not make for yourself any tree beside the altar of your God.
verses.16:22: Nor shall you set up a pillar for yourself, things which the Lord your God hates.
verses.17:1: You shall not sacrifice to the Lord your God a calf or a sheep in which there is a blemish, any evil defect; for that is an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.17:2: Now if there is found within one of your cities, which the Lord your God gives you, a man or a woman who does what is evil before the Lord your God, in transgressing His covenant,
verses.17:3: and goes and serves other gods and worships them, whether the sun or the moon or any of the host of heaven, which He has not commanded,
verses.17:4: and it is reported to you, then you shall inquire diligently; and behold, if the matter is indeed true, that this abomination has been committed in Israel,
verses.17:5: then you shall take out that man or that woman, and you shall stone them with stones, and they shall die.
verses.17:6: On the testimony of two witnesses or three witnesses, he who is to die shall be put to death; he shall not be put to death on the testimony of one witness.
verses.17:7: And the hand of the witnesses shall be the first against him to put him to death, and afterward the hand of the people; so you shall put away the evil one from among yourselves.
verses.17:8: Now if a matter in judgment is too difficult for you—between blood and blood, between judgment and judgment, between stroke and stroke, and between dispute and dispute, matters of judgment in your cities—then you shall arise and go up to the place that the Lord your God chooses there,
verses.17:9: and you shall come to the judge who shall be in those days; and having inquired, they shall declare the judgment to you.
