verses.17:10: And you shall act according to the decision that they declare to you from the place that the Lord your God chooses, and you shall be careful to do all that is ordained as law for you.
verses.17:11: According to the law and according to the judgment that they tell you, you shall do; you shall not turn aside from the word that they declare to you, to the right or to the left.
verses.17:12: And the man who acts presumptuously, so as not to obey the priest who stands to minister in the name of the Lord your God, or the judge who shall be in those days, that man shall die; and you shall put away the evil one from Israel.
verses.17:13: And all the people shall hear and fear, and shall no longer act ungodly.
verses.17:14: When you enter into the land which the Lord your God gives you, and inherit it and dwell in it, and say, "I will appoint a ruler over myself, just like the rest of the nations around me,"
verses.17:15: you shall surely appoint over yourself a ruler whom the Lord God chooses. From among your brethren you shall appoint a ruler over yourself; you may not appoint a foreign man over yourself, because he is not your brother.
verses.17:16: for he shall not multiply horses for himself, nor shall he turn the people back to Egypt in order to multiply horses for himself; for the Lord has said, "You shall not again return by this way."
verses.17:17: Neither shall he multiply wives for himself, nor shall his heart turn aside; nor shall he greatly multiply silver and gold for himself.
verses.17:18: And when he is seated in his rule, he shall write for himself this second law in a book from the priests, the Levites.
verses.17:19: And it shall be with him, and he shall read in it all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear the Lord your God and to observe all these commandments and these statutes, to do them;
verses.17:20: that his heart may not be lifted up above his brethren, and that he may not turn aside from the commandments to the right or to the left, so that he may prolong his days in his rule, he and his sons among the sons of Israel.
verses.18:1: The priests, the Levites—the whole tribe of Levi—shall have no portion nor inheritance with Israel; the offerings by fire of the Lord are their inheritance, and they shall eat them.
verses.18:2: And they shall have no inheritance among their brethren; the Lord Himself is his inheritance, as He spoke to him.
verses.18:3: And this shall be the due of the priests—what comes from the people, from those who offer sacrifices, whether a calf or a sheep: he shall give to the priest the shoulder, the cheeks, and the stomach.
verses.18:4: And the firstfruits of your grain and your wine and your oil, and the firstfruits of the shearings of your sheep, you shall give to him.
verses.18:5: For the Lord has chosen him out of all your tribes to stand before the Lord God, to minister and to bless in His name, he and his sons among the sons of Israel.
verses.18:6: Now if a Levite comes from one of the cities out of all the sons of Israel where he sojourns, according as his soul desires, to the place that He chooses,
verses.18:7: he shall minister in the name of the Lord his God, just like all his brethren the Levites who stand there before the Lord your God.
verses.18:8: He shall eat an apportioned share, besides the sale according to his father's house.
verses.18:9: When you enter into the land which the Lord your God gives you, you shall not learn to do according to the abominations of those nations.
verses.18:10: There shall not be found among you anyone who purifies his son and his daughter in fire, or practices divination, or interprets omens and practices augury, or with spells
verses.18:11: chants an incantation, or a ventriloquist and an observer of portents, or one who inquires of the dead.
verses.18:12: For everyone who does these things is an abomination to the Lord your God; and because of these abominations the Lord will utterly destroy them from before you.
verses.18:13: You shall be blameless before the Lord your God.
verses.18:14: For these nations whom you are dispossessing listen to omens and divinations; but to you the Lord your God has not given it to be so.
verses.18:15: The Lord your God will raise up for you a Prophet like me from among your brethren; Him you shall hear,
verses.18:16: according to all that you asked of the Lord your God in Horeb on the day of the assembly, saying, "We will not again hear the voice of the Lord your God, nor will we see this great fire anymore, so that we may not die."
verses.18:17: And the Lord said to me, "All that they have spoken to you is well spoken.
verses.18:18: I will raise up for them a Prophet like you from among their brethren, and I will put My words in His mouth, and He shall speak to them according to all that I command Him.
verses.18:19: And as for the man who does not hear whatever that Prophet speaks in My name, I Myself will require it of him.
verses.18:20: Yet the prophet who acts ungodly to speak a word in My name which I have not commanded to be spoken, and whoever speaks in the name of other gods, that prophet shall die."
verses.18:21: And if you say in your heart, "How shall we know the word that the Lord has not spoken?"
verses.18:22: whatever that prophet speaks in the name of the Lord, and it does not happen and does not come to pass, that is the word which the Lord has not spoken; in ungodliness that prophet has spoken it, and you shall not spare him.
verses.19:1: Now when the Lord your God destroys the nations whose land God is giving to you, and you inherit them and dwell in their cities and in their houses,
verses.19:2: you shall set apart three cities for yourself in the midst of your land, which the Lord your God is giving to you.
verses.19:3: Measure out the road for yourself, and you shall divide into three parts the borders of your land, which the Lord your God apportions to you, and there shall be a refuge there for every manslayer.
verses.19:4: And this shall be the ordinance of the manslayer who flees there and shall live: whoever strikes his neighbor unknowingly, and he was not hating him before yesterday and the third day.
verses.19:5: And whoever enters with his neighbor into the forest to gather wood, and his hand swings aside with the axe as he cuts the wood, and the iron slips off from the wood and strikes his neighbor, and he dies, that man shall flee to one of these cities and live;
verses.19:6: lest the avenger of blood pursue after the slayer, because he is heated in his heart, and overtake him, if the way is too long, and strike his life; yet for this man there is no judgment of death, because he was not hating him before yesterday nor before the third day.
verses.19:7: Therefore I command you this word, saying, "You shall set apart three cities for yourself."
verses.19:8: And if the Lord your God enlarges your borders, in the manner He swore to your fathers, and the Lord gives you all the land which He said He would give to your fathers,
verses.19:9: if you listen to do all these commandments which I command you today, to love the Lord your God and to walk in all His ways all the days, then you shall add for yourself three more cities in addition to these three;
verses.19:10: and innocent blood shall not be shed in the land which the Lord your God is giving to you as an inheritance, and there shall not be among you one guilty of blood.
verses.19:11: But if there is among you a man who hates his neighbor, and lies in wait for him, and rises up against him and strikes his life so that he dies, and flees to one of these cities,
verses.19:12: then the elders of his city shall send and take him from there, and deliver him into the hands of the avengers of blood, and he shall die.
verses.19:13: Your eye shall not spare him, and you shall cleanse the innocent blood from Israel, and it shall be well with you.
verses.19:14: You shall not move the boundaries of your neighbor, which your fathers set up in the inheritance that you have received in the land which the Lord your God is giving to you as an allotment.
verses.19:15: One witness shall not stand to testify against a man concerning any iniquity or concerning any offense or concerning any sin that he may commit; upon the mouth of two witnesses and upon the mouth of three witnesses every word shall be established.
verses.19:16: And if an unrighteous witness stands up against a man, charging him with ungodliness,
verses.19:17: then the two men who have the dispute shall know before the Lord, and before the priests, and before the judges who shall be in those days,
verses.19:18: and the judges shall inquire diligently, and behold, an unrighteous witness has testified unrighteous things—he has stood up against his brother—
verses.19:19: then you shall do to him in the manner he wickedly schemed to do against his brother; and you shall remove the wicked one from among yourselves.
verses.19:20: And the rest shall hear and fear, and shall no longer continue to act according to this wicked word among you.
verses.19:21: Your eye shall not spare him: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
verses.20:1: Now when you go out to war against your enemies, and you see horse and rider and a people more numerous than you, you shall not be afraid of them; for the Lord your God is with you, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.20:2: And it shall be, when you draw near to the battle, that the priest shall approach and speak to the people,
verses.20:3: and shall say to them, "Hear, O Israel: you are marching today to the battle against your enemies; do not let your heart grow faint, do not fear, nor be broken, nor turn aside from before their face,
verses.20:4: for the Lord your God is He who goes forward with you, to fight together with you against your enemies, to deliver you."
verses.20:5: And the scribes shall speak to the people, saying, "Who is the man who has built a new house and has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle and another man dedicate it.
verses.20:6: And who is the man who has planted a vineyard and has not rejoiced from it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle and another man rejoice from it.
verses.20:7: And who is the man who has betrothed a woman and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle and another man take her."
verses.20:8: And the scribes shall speak further to the people and say, "Who is the man who is fearful and cowardly in heart? Let him go and return to his house, lest he make the heart of his brother cowardly like his own."
verses.20:9: And it shall be, when the scribes finish speaking to the people, that they shall appoint commanders of the army to lead the people.
verses.20:10: Now when you approach a city to make war against them, then summon them with peace.
verses.20:11: If they answer you peaceably and open to you, then it shall be that all the people who are found in it shall be tributary to you and obedient to you.
verses.20:12: But if they do not obey you, and make war against you, you shall besiege it,
verses.20:13: until the Lord your God delivers it into your hands; and you shall strike every male of it with the slaughter of the sword,
verses.20:14: except the women and the dependents; and whatever is in the city and all the belongings you shall plunder for yourself, and you shall eat all the plunder of your enemies whom the Lord your God is giving to you.
verses.20:15: Thus you shall do to all the cities that are very far from you; not from the cities of these nations
verses.20:16: whose land the Lord your God is giving to you to inherit shall you leave alive anything that breathes,
verses.20:17: but you shall surely devote them to destruction—the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite—just as the Lord your God has commanded you,
verses.20:18: lest they teach you to do all their abominations which they have done to their gods, and you sin before the Lord your God.
verses.20:19: Now if you besiege one city for many days, making war against it to capture it, you shall not destroy its trees by laying iron upon them; rather, you shall eat from it, and you shall not cut it down. Is the tree in the field a man, to enter into the siegework from before your face?
verses.20:20: Only a tree which you know does not bear edible fruit, that one you shall destroy and cut down, and you shall build a siegework against the city that makes war against you, until it is delivered up.
verses.21:1: Now if a slain man is found in the land which the Lord your God is giving to you to inherit, fallen in the plain, and they do not know who struck him,
verses.21:2: your elders and your judges shall go out, and they shall measure to the cities that are around the slain man.
verses.21:3: And it shall be, for the city that is nearest to the slain man, that the elders of that city shall take a heifer from the herd, which has not been worked and which has not pulled a yoke;
verses.21:4: and the elders of that city shall bring the heifer down into a rough ravine, which is neither worked nor sown, and they shall hamstring the heifer in the ravine.
verses.21:5: And the priests, the Levites, shall come near, for the Lord God has chosen them to stand before Him and to bless in His name, and by their mouth shall be every dispute and every assault.
verses.21:6: And all the elders of that city who are nearest to the slain man shall wash their hands over the head of the heifer that was hamstrung in the ravine,
verses.21:7: and they shall answer and say, "Our hands have not shed this blood, and our eyes have not seen it.
verses.21:8: Be merciful to Your people Israel, whom You have redeemed, O Lord, so that innocent blood may not be among Your people Israel." And the blood shall be atoned for them.
verses.21:9: So you shall remove the innocent blood from among yourselves, if you do what is good and what is pleasing before the Lord your God.
verses.21:10: Now when you go out to war against your enemies, and the Lord your God delivers them into your hands, and you plunder their spoil,
verses.21:11: and you see among the spoil a woman beautiful in appearance, and you desire her and take her for yourself as a wife,
verses.21:12: then you shall bring her inside your house, and you shall shave her head and pare her nails;
verses.21:13: and you shall remove the garments of captivity from her, and she shall sit in your house and weep for her father and her mother for the days of a month; and after this you shall go in to her and be joined to her in marriage, and she shall be your wife.
verses.21:14: And it shall be, if you do not want her, that you shall send her away free, and she shall by no means be sold for silver; you shall not deal treacherously with her, because you have humbled her.
verses.21:15: Now if a man has two wives, one of them loved and one of them hated, and both the loved and the hated give birth for him, and the firstborn son belongs to the hated one,
verses.21:16: then it shall be, on the day when he apportions his possessions as an inheritance to his sons, that he shall not be able to grant the birthright to the son of the loved one, overlooking the son of the hated one, the firstborn;
verses.21:17: rather, he shall acknowledge the firstborn son of the hated one by giving him a double portion from all that is found with him; for this one is the beginning of his children, and to him belongs the birthright.
verses.21:18: Now if anyone has a disobedient and contentious son, who does not obey the voice of his father and the voice of his mother, and they discipline him and he does not listen to them,
verses.21:19: then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of the place,
verses.21:20: and they shall say to the men of their city, "This son of ours is disobedient and contentious; he does not obey our voice; carousing in revelry, he is given to drunkenness."
verses.21:21: Then the men of his city shall stone him with stones, and he shall die; and you shall remove the wicked one from among yourselves, and the rest shall hear and fear.
verses.21:22: Now if there is in anyone a sin whose judgment is death, and he dies, and you hang him upon a tree,
verses.21:23: his body shall not remain overnight upon the tree, but you shall surely bury it on that day, for everyone who is hanged upon a tree is accursed by God; and you shall not defile the land which the Lord your God is giving to you as an inheritance.
verses.22:1: You shall not see your brother's calf or his sheep going astray in the way and overlook them; you shall surely bring them back to your brother and restore them to him.
verses.22:2: And if your brother is not near you, or if you do not know him, you shall bring it inside your house, and it shall be with you until your brother seeks them, and you shall restore them to him.
verses.22:3: So you shall do with his donkey, and so you shall do concerning every lost thing of your brother; whatever is lost from him and you find, you may not overlook it.
verses.22:4: You shall not see your brother's donkey or his calf fallen in the way; do not overlook them; you shall surely lift them up with him.
verses.22:5: The articles of a man shall not be upon a woman, nor shall a man put on a woman's garment; for everyone who does these things is an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.22:6: And if you come upon a nest of birds before you in the way, whether in any tree or upon the ground, with fledglings or eggs, and the mother is brooding over the fledglings or over the eggs, you shall not take the mother with the young;
verses.22:7: you shall surely send the mother away, but the young ones you may take for yourself, that it may go well with you and that you may live many days.
verses.22:8: If you build a new house, then you shall make a parapet for your roof, and you shall not cause bloodshed in your house if anyone should fall from it.
verses.22:9: You shall not sow your vineyard with a double crop, lest the produce and the seed that one sows be consecrated together with the produce of your vineyard.
verses.22:10: You shall not plow with a calf and a donkey together.
verses.22:11: You shall not put on a mixed garment, wool and linen together.
verses.22:12: You shall make twisted tassels for yourself upon the four corners of your cloaks with which you cover yourself.
verses.22:13: And if any man takes a wife and lives with her, and hates her,
verses.22:14: and lays unfounded accusations against her, and brings down an evil name upon her, and says, "I took this woman, and when I approached her, I did not find the tokens of her virginity";
verses.22:15: then the father and the mother of the maiden shall take and bring out the tokens of the maiden's virginity to the council of elders at the gate,
verses.22:16: and the father of the maiden shall say to the council of elders, "I gave this daughter of mine to this man as a wife, and having hated her,
verses.22:17: now this man lays unfounded accusations against her, saying, 'I did not find tokens of virginity in your daughter.' Yet these are the tokens of my daughter's virginity." And they shall spread out the garment before the council of elders of the city.
verses.22:18: And the council of elders of that city shall take that man and chastise him,
verses.22:19: and they shall fine him one hundred shekels and give them to the father of the young woman, because he brought out an evil name upon an Israelite virgin; and she shall be his wife; he may not send her away for all time.
verses.22:20: But if this matter is true, and tokens of virginity are not found for the young woman,
verses.22:21: then they shall bring out the young woman to the doors of her father, and they shall stone her with stones and she shall die, because she has committed folly among the sons of Israel, defiling the house of her father with harlotry; and you shall remove the evil one from among yourselves.
verses.22:22: And if a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, you shall put both of them to death, the man who lay with the woman and the woman; and you shall remove the evil one from Israel.
verses.22:23: And if there is a virgin maiden betrothed to a husband, and a man finds her in a city and lies with her,
verses.22:24: you shall bring both of them out to the gate of their city, and they shall be stoned with stones and shall die—the young woman, because she did not cry out in the city, and the man, because he humbled his neighbor's wife; and you shall remove the evil one from among yourselves.
verses.22:25: But if a man finds the betrothed maiden in a plain and forces her and lies with her, you shall put to death only the one who lay with her,
verses.22:26: and in the young woman there is no sin worthy of death. As when a man rises up against his neighbor and murders his life, so is this matter;
verses.22:27: for he found her in the field; the betrothed young woman cried out, and there was no one to help her.
verses.22:28: And if any man finds a virgin maiden who is not betrothed, and forces her and lies with her, and he is found out,
verses.22:29: then the man who lay with her shall give to the father of the young woman fifty didrachmas of silver, and she shall be his wife, because he humbled her; he may not send her away for all time.
verses.23:1: A man shall not take his father's wife, nor shall he uncover his father's covering.
verses.23:2: Neither a eunuch who is crushed nor one who is castrated shall enter into the assembly of the Lord.
verses.23:3: One born of a harlot shall not enter into the assembly of the Lord.
verses.23:4: An Ammonite or a Moabite shall not enter into the assembly of the Lord; even to the tenth generation he shall not enter into the assembly of the Lord, even forever,
verses.23:5: because they did not meet you with bread and water on the way when you were coming out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Mesopotamia to curse you;
verses.23:6: yet the Lord your God would not listen to Balaam, and the Lord your God turned the curses into a blessing, because the Lord your God loved you.
verses.23:7: You shall not speak peaceable words to them nor what is beneficial to them all your days forever.
verses.23:8: You shall not abhor an Idumean, for he is your brother; you shall not abhor an Egyptian, for you were a sojourner in his land;
verses.23:9: if sons are born to them, in the third generation they shall enter into the assembly of the Lord.
verses.23:10: And if you go out to encamp against your enemies, then you shall guard yourself from every evil thing.
verses.23:11: If there is among you a man who is not clean because of his emission by night, then he shall go out into the camp;
verses.23:12: and it shall be toward evening that he shall wash his body with water, and when the sun has set, he shall enter into the camp.
verses.23:13: And you shall have a place outside the camp, and you shall go out there.
verses.23:14: And you shall have a peg upon your belt, and it shall be that when you sit down outside, you shall dig with it, and drawing earth over it, you shall cover your indecency;
verses.23:15: for the Lord your God walks about in your camp to deliver you and to hand over your enemy before your face; and your camp shall be holy, and no unseemliness of any matter shall be seen in you, lest He turn away from you.
verses.23:16: You shall not hand over a servant to his master, who has attached himself to you from his master;
verses.23:17: he shall dwell with you, among you; he shall dwell wherever it pleases him; you shall not oppress him.
verses.23:18: There shall not be a harlot from the daughters of Israel, and there shall not be a fornicator from the sons of Israel; there shall not be a female cult initiate from the daughters of Israel, and there shall not be a male cult initiate from the sons of Israel.
verses.23:19: You shall not bring the hire of a harlot or the price of a dog into the house of the Lord your God for any vow, for both of these are an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.23:20: You shall not lend at interest to your brother—interest on silver and interest on food and interest on anything that you may lend out;
verses.23:21: to a foreigner you may lend at interest, but to your brother you shall not lend at interest, that the Lord your God may bless you in all your works upon the land into which you are entering to inherit it.
verses.23:22: And if you vow a vow to the Lord your God, you shall not delay to fulfill it, for the Lord your God will surely require it from you, and there will be sin in you;
verses.23:23: but if you choose not to vow, there is no sin in you.
verses.23:24: You shall guard what goes forth through your lips, and you shall perform just as you vowed to God the gift that you spoke with your mouth.
verses.23:25: And if you enter into your neighbor's standing grain, you may gather heads of grain with your hands, but you shall by no means put a sickle to your neighbor's standing grain.
verses.23:26: And if you enter into your neighbor's vineyard, you may eat grapes enough to satisfy your soul, but you shall not put any into a vessel.
verses.24:1: Now if anyone takes a wife and dwells with her, and it comes to pass that she does not find favor before him because he has found an unseemly thing in her, and he writes for her a bill of divorce and puts it into her hands, and sends her out of his house,
verses.24:2: and having departed, she becomes another man's wife,
verses.24:3: and the latter husband hates her, and writes for her a bill of divorce and puts it into her hands and sends her out of his house, and the latter husband who took her for himself as a wife dies,
verses.24:4: her former husband who sent her away shall not be able to turn back and take her to himself as a wife after she has been defiled, for that is an abomination before the Lord your God; and you shall not defile the land which the Lord your God gives you as an inheritance.
verses.24:5: Now if anyone has recently taken a wife, he shall not go out to war, and no duty shall be laid upon him; he shall be exempt in his house for one year; he shall gladden his wife whom he has taken.
verses.24:6: You shall not take as a pledge a millstone nor an upper millstone, for he takes a life as a pledge.
verses.24:7: And if a man is caught stealing a person from his brethren, the sons of Israel, and having oppressed him, sells him, that thief shall die; and you shall remove the wicked one from among yourselves.
verses.24:8: Take heed to yourself concerning the plague of leprosy; you shall be exceedingly careful to do according to all the law which the priests, the Levites, declare to you; in the manner I commanded you, be careful to do.
verses.24:9: Remember all that the Lord your God did to Miriam on the way, as you were coming out of Egypt.
verses.24:10: If there is a debt with your neighbor, any debt whatever, and you go into his house to take his pledge,
verses.24:11: you shall stand outside, and the man who holds your loan shall bring the pledge outside to you.
verses.24:12: And if the man is poor, you shall not sleep in the pledge;
verses.24:13: you shall surely restore his pledge by the setting of the sun, and he shall sleep in his garment, and he shall bless you, and it shall be mercy for you before the Lord your God.
verses.24:14: You shall not unjustly withhold the wages of one who is poor and needy from among your brethren, or from among the sojourners who are in your cities;
verses.24:15: on the same day you shall pay his wages; the sun shall not go down upon it, for he is poor and has his hope in it, and he will cry out against you to the Lord, and there shall be sin in you.
verses.24:16: Fathers shall not die for children, and sons shall not die for fathers; each one shall die in his own sin.
verses.24:17: You shall not pervert the justice of the sojourner and the orphan and the widow,
verses.24:18: for you were a household servant in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God redeemed you from there; therefore I command you to do this thing.
verses.24:19: Now when you reap a harvest in your field, and forget a sheaf in your field, you shall not turn back to take it; it shall be for the sojourner and for the orphan and for the widow, that the Lord your God may bless you in all the works of your hands.
verses.24:20: And when you gather olives, you shall not turn back to glean what is behind you; it shall be for the sojourner and for the orphan and for the widow; and you shall remember that you were a household servant in the land of Egypt; therefore I command you to do this thing.
verses.24:21: And when you harvest the grapes of your vineyard, you shall not glean it again behind you; it shall be for the sojourner and for the orphan and for the widow,
verses.24:22: and you shall remember that you were a household servant in the land of Egypt; therefore I command you to do this thing.
verses.25:1: Now if a dispute arises between men, and they come forward to judgment, and they vindicate what is right and condemn the ungodly man,
verses.25:2: then it shall be, if the one acting ungodly is worthy of stripes, you shall seat him before them.
verses.25:3: And they shall scourge him with the number forty; they shall not add more; for if you add to scourge him with more stripes than these, your brother will be disgraced before you.
verses.25:4: You shall not muzzle a threshing ox.
verses.25:5: Now if brothers dwell together, and one of them dies, and he had no seed, the wife of the deceased shall not belong outside to a man who is not near of kin; her husband's brother shall go in to her and take her to himself as a wife, and dwell with her.
verses.25:6: And it shall be that the child whom she bears shall be established by the name of the one who has died, and his name shall not be blotted out from Israel.
verses.25:7: But if the man does not wish to take his brother's wife, then the woman shall go up to the gate, to the council of elders, and shall say, "My husband's brother refuses to raise up the name of his brother in Israel; my husband's brother has not been willing."
verses.25:8: And the council of elders of his city shall summon him and speak to him; and if he stands and says, "I do not wish to take her,"
verses.25:9: then his brother's wife shall come forward before the council of elders, and she shall loose his one sandal from his foot, and spit in his face, and answering she shall say, "Thus shall they do to the man who will not build up the house of his brother in Israel."
verses.25:10: And his name shall be called in Israel, "The House of Him Whose Sandal Was Loosed."
verses.25:11: Now if men fight together, a man with his brother, and the wife of one of them comes near to rescue her husband from the hand of the one striking him, and stretching out her hand she seizes his private parts,
verses.25:12: you shall cut off her hand; your eye shall not spare her.
verses.25:13: You shall not have in your bag a weight and a weight, a large or a small;
verses.25:14: there shall not be in your house a measure and a measure, a large or a small;
verses.25:15: a true and just weight you shall have, that you may live many days upon the land which the Lord your God gives you as an inheritance.
verses.25:16: For everyone who does these things, everyone who practices injustice, is an abomination to the Lord your God.
verses.25:17: Remember all that Amalek did to you on the way as you were coming out of the land of Egypt,
verses.25:18: how he withstood you on the way and cut off your rear guard, those who were weary behind you, while you were hungry and weary, and he did not fear God.
verses.25:19: And it shall come to pass, when the Lord your God has given you rest from all your enemies around you in the land which the Lord your God gives you to inherit, you shall blot out the name of Amalek from the earth under heaven; and you shall by no means forget.
verses.26:1: And it shall come to pass, when you enter into the land which the Lord your God gives you to inherit, and you possess it and dwell upon it,
verses.26:2: then you shall take from the firstfruits of the fruits of your land which the Lord your God gives you, and put them into a basket, and go to the place which the Lord your God chooses for His name to be called upon there;
verses.26:3: and you shall come to the priest who shall be in those days, and say to him, "I declare today to the Lord my God that I have entered into the land which the Lord swore to our fathers to give to us."
verses.26:4: And the priest shall take the basket from your hands, and set it before the altar of the Lord your God.
verses.26:5: And answering he shall say before the Lord your God, "My father forsook Syria and went down into Egypt, and sojourned there with a small number, and became there a great nation and a large multitude.
verses.26:6: And the Egyptians mistreated us, and humbled us, and laid hard labors upon us.
verses.26:7: And we cried out to the Lord our God, and the Lord heard our voice, and saw our humiliation and our affliction.
verses.26:8: And the Lord Himself brought us out of Egypt with His great strength and with a mighty hand and a lofty arm, and with great visions and with signs and with wonders;
verses.26:9: and He brought us into this place, and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.26:10: And now, behold, I have brought the firstfruits of the produce of the land which You have given me, O Lord, a land flowing with milk and honey." And you shall worship before the Lord your God;
verses.26:11: and you and your household, and the Levite and the sojourner who is among you, shall rejoice in all the good things which the Lord your God has given you.
verses.26:12: Now when you have finished tithing all the tithe of your produce in the third year, you shall give the second tithe to the Levite and to the sojourner and to the orphan and to the widow, and they shall eat in your cities and rejoice.
verses.26:13: And you shall say before the Lord your God, "I have cleared out the holy things from my house, and have given them to the Levite and to the sojourner and to the orphan and to the widow, according to all the commandments which You commanded me; I have not transgressed Your commandment, nor have I forgotten.
verses.26:14: And I have not eaten of them in my grief, I have not offered of them for an unclean thing, I have not given of them to the dead; I have obeyed the voice of the Lord our God, I have obeyed just as You commanded me.
verses.26:15: Look down from Your holy house, from heaven, and bless Your people Israel and the land which You have given to them, just as You swore to our fathers to give to us a land flowing with milk and honey."
verses.26:16: On this day the Lord your God has commanded you to do all the statutes and the judgments; and you shall keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.26:17: You have chosen God today to be your God, and to walk in all His ways, and to keep the statutes and the judgments, and to obey His voice;
verses.26:18: and the Lord has chosen you today to become for Him a treasured people, just as He spoke, to keep His commandments,
verses.26:19: and for you to be high above all the nations, as He has made you renowned, and a boast, and glorious—that you may be a holy people to the Lord your God, just as He has spoken.
verses.27:1: And Moses and the council of elders of the Israelites commanded, "Observe all these commandments which I command you today.
verses.27:2: And it shall be, on whatever day you cross over the Jordan into the land which the Lord your God gives to you, that you shall set up for yourself great stones and coat them with lime.
verses.27:3: And you shall write upon these stones all the words of this law, when you have crossed over the Jordan, at the time you enter into the land which the Lord, the God of your fathers, gives to you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the Lord, the God of your fathers, spoke to you.
verses.27:4: And it shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, you shall set up these stones, which I command you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with lime.
verses.27:5: And you shall build there an altar to the Lord your God, an altar of stones; you shall not lay iron upon it.
verses.27:6: With whole stones you shall build an altar to the Lord your God, and you shall offer up upon it the burnt offerings to the Lord your God.
verses.27:7: And you shall sacrifice there a sacrifice of deliverance, and you shall eat and be filled, and you shall rejoice before the Lord your God.
verses.27:8: And you shall write upon the stones all this law very clearly."
verses.27:9: And Moses and the priests, the Levites, spoke to all Israel, saying, "Be silent and hear, O Israel; on this day you have become a people to the Lord your God.
verses.27:10: And you shall obey the voice of the Lord your God, and perform all His commandments and His statutes which I command you today."
verses.27:11: And Moses commanded the people on that day, saying,
verses.27:12: "These shall stand to bless the people on Mount Gerizim, when they have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
verses.27:13: And these shall stand for the curse on Mount Ebal: Reuben, Gad and Asher, Zebulun, Dan and Naphtali."
verses.27:14: And the Levites shall answer and say to all Israel with a loud voice:
verses.27:15: "Cursed is the man who makes a carved and molten image, an abomination to the Lord, the work of the hands of craftsmen, and sets it in a secret place." And the people shall answer and say, "So be it."
verses.27:16: "Cursed is the one who dishonors his father or his mother." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.27:17: "Cursed is the one who moves the boundaries of his neighbor." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.27:18: "Cursed is the one who leads a blind man astray on the road." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.27:19: "Cursed is whoever turns aside the justice of a sojourner, an orphan, and a widow." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.27:20: "Cursed is the one who lies with a wife of his father, because he has uncovered the covering of his father." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.27:21: "Cursed is the one who lies with any beast." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.27:22: "Cursed is the one who lies with the sister of his father or his mother." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.27:23: "Cursed is the one who lies with his daughter-in-law." And all the people shall say, "So be it." "Cursed is the one who lies with the sister of his wife." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.27:24: "Cursed is the one who strikes his neighbor by deceit." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.27:25: "Cursed is whoever takes bribes to strike down a life of innocent blood." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.27:26: "Cursed is every man who does not abide in all the words of this law to do them." And all the people shall say, "So be it."
verses.28:1: And it shall come to pass, if you diligently heed the voice of the Lord your God, to keep and to perform all these commandments which I command you today, that the Lord your God shall set you high above all the nations of the earth.
verses.28:2: And all these blessings shall come upon you and find you, if you diligently heed the voice of the Lord your God.
verses.28:3: Blessed are you in the city, and blessed are you in the field.
verses.28:4: Blessed are the offspring of your womb, the herds of your cattle, and the flocks of your sheep.
verses.28:5: Blessed are your storehouses and your reserves.
verses.28:6: Blessed are you in your coming in, and blessed are you in your going out.
verses.28:7: May the Lord your God deliver your enemies who stand against you, crushed before your face; by one way they shall come out against you, and by seven ways they shall flee from before your face.
verses.28:8: May the Lord send the blessing upon you in your storerooms and upon everything to which you put your hand, upon the land which the Lord your God gives you.
verses.28:9: May the Lord raise you up for Himself as a holy people, just as He swore to your fathers, if you heed the voice of the Lord your God and walk in all His ways.
verses.28:10: And all the nations of the earth shall see you, that the name of the Lord is called upon you, and they shall fear you.
verses.28:11: And the Lord your God shall multiply you for good, in the offspring of your womb, and in the produce of your land, and in the offspring of your livestock, upon the land which the Lord swore to your fathers to give you.
verses.28:12: May the Lord open to you His good treasury, the heaven, to give the rain to your land in season, to bless all the works of your hands; and you shall lend to many nations, but you shall not borrow.
verses.28:13: May the Lord your God appoint you as the head and not as the tail, and then you shall be above and shall not be beneath, if you heed the voice of the Lord your God in all things that I command you today to keep.
verses.28:14: You shall not turn aside from any of the commandments which I command you today, to the right or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
verses.28:15: And it shall come to pass, if you do not heed the voice of the Lord your God, to keep all His commandments which I command you today, that all these curses shall come upon you and overtake you.
verses.28:16: Cursed are you in the city, and cursed are you in the field.
verses.28:17: Cursed are your storehouses and your reserves.
verses.28:18: Cursed are the offspring of your womb and the produce of your land, the herds of your cattle and the flocks of your sheep.
verses.28:19: Cursed are you in your going out, and cursed are you in your coming in.
verses.28:20: May the Lord send upon you want, and famine, and consumption upon everything to which you put your hand, until He utterly destroys you, and until He makes you perish swiftly because of your evil practices, because you have forsaken Me.
verses.28:21: May the Lord cause death to cling to you, until He completely consumes you from the land into which you are entering to inherit it.
verses.28:22: May the Lord strike you with distress, and fever, and chill, and inflammation, and blight, and mildew; and they shall pursue you until they destroy you.
verses.28:23: And the heaven that is over your head shall be bronze to you, and the earth that is beneath you shall be iron.
verses.28:24: May the Lord your God make the rain for your land fine dust, and dust shall come down from heaven, until He wipes you out, and until He destroys you swiftly.
verses.28:25: May the Lord make you a visitation before the enemies; by one way you shall go out against them, and by seven ways you shall flee from before their face, and you shall be a dispersion in all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.28:26: And your dead bodies shall be food for the birds of heaven and for the beasts of the earth, and there shall be no one to frighten them away.
verses.28:27: May the Lord strike you with an Egyptian boil upon the seat, and with a malignant scab, and with an itch, so that you cannot be healed.
verses.28:28: May the Lord strike you with madness of blindness and with bewilderment of mind.
verses.28:29: And you shall grope at noon, as a blind man might grope in the darkness, and He shall not prosper your ways; and then you shall be wronged and plundered all the days, and there shall be no one to help.
verses.28:30: You shall take a wife, and another man shall have her; you shall build a house, and you shall not dwell in it; you shall plant a vineyard, and you shall not harvest it.
verses.28:31: Your calf shall be slaughtered before you, and you shall not eat of it; your donkey shall be seized from you, and shall not be restored to you; your sheep shall be given to your enemies,
verses.28:32: and your eyes shall gaze upon them, failing with anguish; your hand shall have no strength.
verses.28:33: A nation which you do not know shall eat the yield of your land and all your labors, and you shall be wronged and crushed all the days.
verses.28:34: And you shall be driven mad because of the sights of your eyes which you shall see.
verses.28:35: May the Lord strike you with a grievous boil upon the knees and upon the legs, so that you cannot be healed, from the sole of your feet to the crown of your head.
verses.28:36: May the Lord lead you away, and your rulers whom you may set over yourself, to a nation which neither you nor your fathers know; and there you shall serve other gods, wood and stone.
verses.28:37: And you shall be there as a riddle, and a proverb, and a tale among all the nations to which the Lord leads you away.
verses.28:38: You shall carry out much seed into the field, and you shall bring in little, for the locust shall devour it.
verses.28:39: You shall plant a vineyard and cultivate it, yet you shall neither drink wine nor rejoice from it, for the worm shall devour it.
verses.28:40: You shall have olive trees in all your borders, yet you shall not anoint yourself with oil, for your olive shall drop off.
verses.28:41: You shall bring forth sons and daughters, yet they shall not be, for they shall go away in captivity.
verses.28:42: The rust shall completely consume all your trees and the produce of your land.
verses.28:43: The sojourner who is among you shall ascend higher and higher, but you shall descend lower and lower.
verses.28:44: He shall lend to you, but you shall not lend to him; he shall be the head, and you shall be the tail.
verses.28:45: And all these curses shall come upon you and pursue you and overtake you, until He utterly destroys you and until He makes you perish, because you did not heed the voice of the Lord your God, to keep His commandments and the ordinances which He commanded you.
verses.28:46: And they shall be signs and wonders upon you, in your seed forever,
verses.28:47: because you did not serve the Lord your God with gladness and a good mind, for the abundance of all things.
verses.28:48: And you shall serve your enemies, whom the Lord shall send against you, in hunger and in want of all things; and He shall put an iron collar upon your neck, until He utterly destroys you.
verses.28:49: The Lord shall bring upon you a nation from afar, from the end of the earth, like the swoop of an eagle, a nation whose voice you shall not understand,
verses.28:50: a nation shameless in countenance, which shall not respect the person of the old man, nor show mercy to the young.
verses.28:51: And it shall devour the offspring of your livestock and the produce of your land, so as not to leave you grain, wine, oil, the herds of your cattle, and the flocks of your sheep, until it destroys you
verses.28:52: and wipes you out in your cities, until the high and fortified walls in which you trust are torn down throughout all your land; and it shall afflict you in your cities which He gave you.
verses.28:53: And you shall eat the offspring of your womb, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, as many as He gave you, in your distress and in your affliction with which your enemy shall afflict you.
verses.28:54: The tender and exceedingly delicate man among you shall look with a begrudging eye upon his brother, and the wife in his bosom, and the remaining children who may be left,
verses.28:55: so as not to give to any one of them from the flesh of his children whom he may devour, because nothing is left to him in your distress and in your affliction with which your enemies shall afflict you in all your cities.
verses.28:56: And the tender and delicate woman among you, whose foot has not ventured to tread upon the earth because of her delicacy, shall look with a begrudging eye upon her husband in her bosom, and her son, and her daughter,
verses.28:57: and upon her afterbirth which comes forth from between her thighs, and upon the child whom she may bear; for she shall devour them in secret because of the want of all things, in your distress and in your affliction with which your enemy shall afflict you in your cities.
verses.28:58: If you do not heed to perform all the words of this law which are written in this book, to fear this honored and wondrous name, the Lord your God,
verses.28:59: then the Lord shall make your plagues extraordinary, and the plagues of your seed, great and wondrous plagues, and evil and persistent diseases.
verses.28:60: And He shall bring back every evil affliction of Egypt, which you dreaded before their face, and they shall cling to you.
verses.28:61: And every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, the Lord shall bring upon you, until He utterly destroys you.
verses.28:62: And you shall be left small in number, whereas you were as the stars of heaven in multitude, because you did not heed the voice of the Lord your God.
verses.28:63: And it shall come to pass, just as the Lord rejoiced over you to do you good, so the Lord shall rejoice over you to utterly destroy you; and you shall be swiftly removed from the land into which you are entering to inherit it.
verses.28:64: And the Lord your God shall scatter you among all the nations, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth, and there you shall serve other gods, wood and stone, whom neither you nor your fathers knew.
verses.28:65: Moreover, even among those nations He shall not give you rest, nor shall there be a resting place for the sole of your foot; and there the Lord shall give you another, disobedient heart, and failing eyes, and a melting soul.
verses.28:66: And your life shall be hanging before your eyes, and you shall fear day and night, and you shall not trust in your life.
verses.28:67: In the morning you shall say, "How might it become evening?" and in the evening you shall say, "How might it become morning?" because of the fear of your heart which you shall fear, and because of the sights of your eyes which you shall see.
verses.28:68: And the Lord shall bring you back to Egypt in ships, by the way of which I said, "You shall not see it again"; and there you shall be sold to your enemies as bondmen and bondwomen, and there shall be no one to buy you.
verses.28:69: These are the words of the covenant which the Lord commanded Moses to establish with the sons of Israel in the land of Moab, besides the covenant which He made with them in Horeb.
verses.29:1: And Moses called all the sons of Israel and said to them, "You have seen all that the Lord did in the land of Egypt before you, to Pharaoh and to his servants and to all his land,
verses.29:2: the great trials which your eyes have seen, the signs and those great wonders.
verses.29:3: Yet the Lord God has not given you a heart to know and eyes to see and ears to hear, to this day.
verses.29:4: And He led you in the wilderness forty years; your garments did not grow old, and your sandals did not wear out from your feet.
verses.29:5: You did not eat bread, nor did you drink wine or strong drink, that you might know that I am the Lord your God.
verses.29:6: And you came to this place, and Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out to meet you in battle;
verses.29:7: and we struck them down and took their land, and I gave it as an inheritance to Reuben and to the Gadites and to the half-tribe of Manasseh.
verses.29:8: Therefore you shall be careful to do all the words of this covenant, that you may understand all that you shall do.
verses.29:9: All of you stand today before the Lord your God: your tribal leaders and your council of elders and your judges and your officers, every man of Israel,
verses.29:10: your wives and your offspring, and the sojourner who is in the midst of your camp, from your woodcutter even to your water-carrier,
verses.29:11: to enter into the covenant of the Lord your God and into His curses, which the Lord your God is making with you today,
verses.29:12: that He may establish you for Himself as a people, and that He shall be your God, just as He spoke to you, and just as He swore to your fathers, Abraham and Isaac and Jacob.
verses.29:13: And not with you alone do I make this covenant and this curse,
verses.29:14: but both with those who are here with us today before the Lord your God, and with those who are not here today.
verses.29:15: For you know how we dwelt in the land of Egypt, and how we passed through the midst of the nations, as you passed through.
verses.29:16: And you saw their abominations and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which are among them;
verses.29:17: lest there be among you a man or a woman or a family or a tribe whose mind has turned away from the Lord your God to go and serve the gods of those nations; lest there be among you a root springing up in gall and bitterness;
verses.29:18: and it shall come to pass, when he hears the words of this curse, that he blesses himself in his heart, saying, 'May good things come to me, for I shall walk in the wandering of my heart,' so that the sinner may not destroy the sinless along with himself—
verses.29:19: God will by no means be willing to pardon him, but then the wrath of the Lord and His jealousy shall blaze forth against that man, and all the curses of this covenant that are written in this book shall cling to him, and the Lord shall blot out his name from under heaven.
verses.29:20: And the Lord shall separate him for calamity from all the sons of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in the book of this law.
verses.29:21: And the next generation shall say—your sons who shall arise after you, and the foreigner who comes from a distant land—and they shall see the plagues of that land and its diseases which the Lord sent upon it,
verses.29:22: brimstone and scorched salt; all its land shall not be sown, nor shall it sprout, nor shall any green thing spring up upon it, just as Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim were overthrown, which the Lord overthrew in fury and wrath.
verses.29:23: And all the nations shall say, 'Why has the Lord done thus to this land? What is this great fury of wrath?'
verses.29:24: And they shall say, 'Because they forsook the covenant of the Lord, the God of their fathers, the things which He covenanted with their fathers when He brought them out of the land of Egypt,
verses.29:25: and they went and served other gods whom they did not know, and whom He had not allotted to them;
verses.29:26: and the Lord was angry in fury against that land, to bring upon it according to all the curses that are written in the book of this law;
verses.29:27: and the Lord removed them from their land in fury and wrath and very great indignation, and cast them out into another land, as it is now.'
verses.29:28: The secret things belong to the Lord your God, but the things revealed belong to you and to your children forever, to do all the words of this law."
verses.30:1: And it shall come to pass, when all these words come upon you, the blessing and the curse which I have set before your face, and you receive them into your heart among all the nations where the Lord shall scatter you,
verses.30:2: and you return to the Lord your God and heed His voice according to all that I command you today, with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.30:3: then the Lord shall heal your sins, and He shall have mercy on you, and again gather you from all the nations among whom the Lord scattered you.
verses.30:4: Even if your dispersion is from one end of heaven to the other end of heaven, from there the Lord your God shall gather you, and from there the Lord your God shall take you.
verses.30:5: And your God shall bring you from there into the land which your fathers inherited, and you shall inherit it; and He shall do good to you and make you more numerous than your fathers.
verses.30:6: And the Lord shall thoroughly cleanse your heart and the heart of your seed, to love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.
verses.30:7: And the Lord your God shall put these curses upon your enemies and upon those who hate you, who persecuted you.
verses.30:8: And you shall return to the Lord and heed the voice of the Lord your God, and you shall do His commandments which I command you today.
verses.30:9: And the Lord your God shall bless you in every work of your hands, in the offspring of your womb and in the produce of your land and in the offspring of your livestock. For the Lord your God shall turn again to rejoice over you for good, just as He rejoiced over your fathers,
verses.30:10: if you heed the voice of the Lord your God, to keep His commandments and His statutes and His judgments which are written in the book of this law, if you return to the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.30:11: For this commandment which I command you today is not too heavy, nor is it far from you.
verses.30:12: It is not in heaven above, that one should say, "Who shall ascend for us into heaven and take it for us, and having heard it we shall do it?"
verses.30:13: Nor is it beyond the sea, that one should say, "Who shall cross over for us to the other side of the sea, and take it for us and make it heard to us, and we shall do it?"
verses.30:14: The word is very near you, in your mouth and in your heart and in your hands, to do it.
verses.30:15: Behold, I have set before your face today life and death, good and evil.
verses.30:16: If you heed the commandments of the Lord your God which I command you today, to love the Lord your God, to walk in all His ways, and to keep His statutes and His judgments, then you shall live and become many, and the Lord your God shall bless you in all the land into which you are entering to inherit it.
verses.30:17: But if your heart turns away and you do not heed, and being led astray you worship other gods and serve them,
verses.30:18: I declare to you today that you shall surely perish, and you shall by no means live many days upon the land into which you are crossing the Jordan to inherit it.
verses.30:19: I call both heaven and earth as witnesses against you today: I have set before your face life and death, the blessing and the curse; choose life, that both you and your seed may live,
verses.30:20: to love the Lord your God, to heed His voice, and to hold fast to Him; for this is your life and the length of your days, that you may dwell upon the land which the Lord swore to your fathers, Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, to give to them.
verses.31:1: And Moses finished speaking all these words to all the sons of Israel.
verses.31:2: And he said to them, "I am one hundred and twenty years old today; I shall no longer be able to go in and go out. And the Lord said to me, 'You shall not cross over this Jordan.'
verses.31:3: The Lord your God is He who goes before your face; He shall utterly destroy these nations from before your face, and you shall take possession of them; and Joshua is he who goes before your face, just as the Lord has spoken.
verses.31:4: And the Lord your God shall do to them as He did to Sihon and Og, the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, and to their land, even as He utterly destroyed them,
verses.31:5: and the Lord delivered them over to you; and you shall do to them just as I have commanded you.
verses.31:6: Be courageous and strong; do not fear, nor be dismayed, nor be terrified before their face; for the Lord your God is He who goes forward with you, among you; He will by no means fail you, nor will He abandon you."
verses.31:7: And Moses called Joshua and said to him in the sight of all Israel, "Be courageous and strong; for you shall enter before the face of this people into the land which the Lord swore to our fathers to give to them, and you shall give it as an inheritance to them.
verses.31:8: And the Lord, who journeys along with you, will not fail you nor by any means abandon you; do not fear, nor be dismayed."
verses.31:9: And Moses wrote the words of this law in a book, and gave it to the priests who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and to the elders of the sons of Israel.
verses.31:10: And Moses commanded them in that day, saying, "After seven years, at the appointed time of the year of release, at the Feast of Tabernacles,
verses.31:11: when all Israel gathers together to appear before the Lord your God in the place which the Lord shall choose, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing,
verses.31:12: assembling the people—the men and the women and the little ones, and the sojourner who is in your cities—that they may hear and that they may learn to fear the Lord your God, and they shall listen to perform all the words of this law;
verses.31:13: and their sons, who do not know, shall hear and learn to fear the Lord your God all the days that they live upon the land into which you are crossing over the Jordan there to inherit it."
verses.31:14: And the Lord said to Moses, "Behold, the days of your death have drawn near; call Joshua, and stand by the doors of the tabernacle of testimony, and I will give him a charge." And Moses and Joshua went to the tabernacle of testimony, and they stood by the doors of the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.31:15: And the Lord descended in a cloud, and stood by the doors of the tabernacle of testimony; and the pillar of the cloud stood by the doors of the tabernacle.
verses.31:16: And the Lord said to Moses, "Behold, you are about to sleep with your fathers; and this people will rise up and play the harlot after foreign gods of the land into which it is entering, and they will forsake Me and break My covenant which I made with them.
verses.31:17: And I will be angry with wrath against them in that day, and I will forsake them and turn away My face from them, and it shall become prey to be devoured; and many evils and afflictions shall find it, and it will say in that day, 'Because the Lord my God is not in me, these evils have found me.'
verses.31:18: And I will surely turn away My face from them in that day on account of all the evils which they have done, because they turned away to foreign gods.
verses.31:19: And write the words of this song, and teach it to the sons of Israel, and put it into their mouth, that this song may be for Me face to face, bearing witness among the sons of Israel.
verses.31:20: For I will bring them into the good land which I swore to their fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey; and they shall eat, and having been filled they shall be satiated, and they shall turn to foreign gods and provoke Me and break My covenant.
verses.31:21: And this song shall stand against them, bearing witness face to face; for it shall by no means be forgotten from the mouth of their seed. For I know their wickedness, all that they are doing here today, before I bring them into the good land which I swore to their fathers."
verses.31:22: And Moses wrote this song in that day, and taught it to the sons of Israel.
verses.31:23: And he charged Joshua and said, "Be courageous and strong; for you shall bring the sons of Israel into the land which the Lord swore to them, and He Himself will be with you."
verses.31:24: Now when Moses had finished writing all the words of this law in a book until the very end,
verses.31:25: then he commanded the Levites who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord, saying,
verses.31:26: "Take the book of this law and place it at the side of the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, and it shall be there among you for a witness;
verses.31:27: for I know your provocation and your stiff neck. For while I am still living with you today, you have been provoking God to bitterness; how shall it not be so even after my death?
verses.31:28: Assemble to me your tribal leaders and your judges and your scribes, that I may speak all these words in their hearing, and I call both heaven and earth to witness against them.
verses.31:29: For I know that after my passing you will surely act lawlessly and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you—evils at the end of the days—because you will do what is wicked in the sight of the Lord, to provoke Him to anger by the works of your hands."
verses.31:30: And Moses spoke in the hearing of the entire assembly the words of this song until the very end.
verses.32:1: Give heed, O heaven, and I will speak; and let the earth hear words from my mouth.
verses.32:2: Let my utterance be awaited like rain, and let my words descend like dew, like a heavy shower upon field grass, and like falling snow upon the green herb.
verses.32:3: For I have called upon the name of the Lord; give greatness to our God.
verses.32:4: God—His works are true, and all His ways are judgments; a faithful God, and there is no unrighteousness; righteous and holy is the Lord.
verses.32:5: They have sinned—not children to Him, blemished ones; a crooked and perverse generation.
verses.32:6: Do you thus repay the Lord these things, O foolish people and not wise? Is not this very One your Father who acquired you and made you?
verses.32:7: Remember the days of old; understand the years of generations to generations. Ask your father, and he will declare it to you; your elders, and they will tell you.
verses.32:8: When the Most High divided the nations, when He scattered the sons of Adam, He established the boundaries of the nations according to the number of the angels of God.
verses.32:9: And His people Jacob became the portion of the Lord, Israel the measured allotment of His inheritance.
verses.32:10: He sustained him in the wilderness, in the thirst of burning heat, in a waterless land; He encircled him and instructed him, and guarded him as the pupil of an eye.
verses.32:11: As an eagle shelters its nest and yearned over its young, spreading out its wings, it received them and took them up upon its back.
verses.32:12: The Lord alone led them; there was no strange god with them.
verses.32:13: He brought them up upon the strength of the earth; He fed them the produce of the fields; they sucked honey from the rock, and oil from the solid rock;
verses.32:14: butter of cattle and milk of sheep, with the fat of lambs and rams, of young bulls and male goats, with the fat of the kidneys of wheat; and he drank wine, the blood of the grape.
verses.32:15: And Jacob ate and was filled, and the beloved one kicked; he grew fat, he grew thick, he grew broad; and he forsook God who made him, and departed from God his Savior.
verses.32:16: They provoked Me to anger over strange gods; with their abominations they embittered Me.
verses.32:17: They sacrificed to demons and not to God, to gods whom they did not know; new and recent ones have come, whom their fathers did not know.
verses.32:18: You forsook God who fathered you, and you forgot God who nourishes you.
verses.32:19: And the Lord saw and was moved to jealousy, and He was provoked because of anger at His sons and daughters.
verses.32:20: And He said, "I will turn away My face from them, and I will show what shall happen to them in the last days; for it is a perverted generation, sons in whom there is no faithfulness.
verses.32:21: They have provoked Me to jealousy by that which is not God; they have angered Me with their idols. And I will provoke them to jealousy by that which is not a nation; by a nation without understanding I will move them to wrath.
verses.32:22: For a fire has been kindled from My wrath; it shall burn down to Hades below; it shall devour the earth and its produce; it shall set ablaze the foundations of the mountains.
verses.32:23: I will gather evils against them, and I will wage war upon them with My arrows.
verses.32:24: Wasting away with famine and the devouring of birds, and incurable convulsion—I will send the teeth of wild beasts against them, with the venom of creatures crawling upon the earth.
verses.32:25: Outside, the sword shall make them childless, and from the inner chambers, terror—young man together with virgin, nursing infant with the aged elder.
verses.32:26: I said, 'I will scatter them, and I will cause the remembrance of them to cease from among men,'
verses.32:27: were it not for the wrath of enemies, lest they endure long, lest the adversaries join together in attack, lest they say, 'Our high hand, and not the Lord, has done all these things.'"
verses.32:28: It is a nation that has lost counsel, and there is no understanding in them.
verses.32:29: They did not have the wisdom to understand; let them receive these things for the time to come.
verses.32:30: How shall one pursue a thousand, and two put ten thousands to flight, unless God had sold them, and the Lord had delivered them up?
verses.32:31: For their gods are not like our God; and our enemies are senseless.
verses.32:32: For their vine is from the vine of Sodom, and their vine branch is from Gomorrah; their grape is a grape of gall, a cluster of bitterness to them;
verses.32:33: their wine is the venom of serpents, and the incurable venom of asps.
verses.32:34: Behold, are not these things gathered together with Me, and sealed up in My treasuries?
verses.32:35: In the day of vengeance I will repay, at the time when their foot slips; for the day of destruction is near for them, and the things prepared for you are at hand.
verses.32:36: For the Lord will judge His people, and He will be moved to compassion over His servants; for He saw them enfeebled, and failing in calamity, and utterly spent.
verses.32:37: And the Lord said, "Where are their gods, in whom they trusted,
verses.32:38: the fat of whose sacrifices you ate, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them arise and help you, and let them become protectors for you.
verses.32:39: See, see that I am He, and there is no god besides Me; I put to death, and I will make alive; I will strike, and I will heal; and there is no one who shall deliver out of My hands.
verses.32:40: For I will lift up My hand to heaven, and I will swear by My right hand, and I will say, 'I live forever.'
verses.32:41: For I will sharpen My sword like lightning, and My hand shall lay hold on judgment; and I will render justice to the enemies, and I will repay those who hate Me;
verses.32:42: I will make My arrows drunk with the blood of the wounded and of captivity, from the head of the rulers of the enemies."
verses.32:43: Rejoice, O heavens, together with Him, and let the sons of God worship Him; rejoice, O nations, with His people, and let all the angels of God be strong in Him; for He avenges the blood of His sons, and He will take vengeance, and He will repay justice to the enemies; and He will repay those who hate Him, and the Lord will cleanse the land of His people.
verses.32:44: And Moses wrote this song on that day, and taught it to the sons of Israel; and Moses entered and spoke all the words of this law into the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.32:45: And Moses finished speaking to all Israel;
verses.32:46: and he said to them, "Set your heart upon all these words which I testify to you today, which you shall command your sons, to keep and to do all the words of this law.
verses.32:47: For this is not an empty word for you, because this is your life; and on account of this word you shall prolong your days upon the land into which you are crossing over the Jordan to inherit."
verses.32:48: And the Lord spoke to Moses on this day, saying,
verses.32:49: "Go up to Mount Abarim, this Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Canaan opposite Jericho, and view the land of Canaan, which I give to the sons of Israel;
verses.32:50: and die on the mountain to which you are going up, and be added to your people, just as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor and was added to his people;
verses.32:51: because you disobeyed My word among the sons of Israel at the water of Strife of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin, because you did not sanctify Me among the sons of Israel.
verses.32:52: You shall see the land from opposite it, and you shall not enter there."
verses.33:1: And this is the blessing with which Moses, the man of God, blessed the sons of Israel before his death.
verses.33:2: And he said, "The Lord has come from Sinai, and has appeared to us from Seir; He hastened from Mount Paran with myriads of Kadesh; at His right hand were angels with Him.
verses.33:3: And He spared His people, and all the sanctified ones are under Your hands; these also are beneath You, and he received from His words,
verses.33:4: a law which Moses commanded you, an inheritance for the congregations of Jacob.
verses.33:5: And there shall be a ruler in the beloved, when the rulers of the peoples are gathered together with the tribes of Israel.
verses.33:6: Let Reuben live and not die, and let him be many in number."
verses.33:7: And this is for Judah: "Hear, O Lord, the voice of Judah, and may You come to his people; his hands shall contend for him, and You shall be a helper from the enemies."
verses.33:8: And of Levi he said, "Give to Levi his manifestations and his truth to the holy man, whom they tested at Testing, and whom they reviled at the water of Contradiction,
verses.33:9: who says to his father and to his mother, 'I have not seen you,' and did not acknowledge his brethren, and disowned his sons; he kept Your oracles, and preserved Your covenant.
verses.33:10: They shall declare Your ordinances to Jacob, and Your law to Israel; they shall place incense in Your wrath continually upon Your altar.
verses.33:11: Bless, O Lord, his strength, and accept the works of his hands; shatter the loins of the enemies who have risen up against him, and let those who hate him not rise up."
verses.33:12: And of Benjamin he said, "Beloved by the Lord, he shall dwell in confidence; God overshadows him all the days, and between his shoulders He has rested."
verses.33:13: And of Joseph he said, "By the blessing of the Lord is his land, from the seasons of heaven and dew, and from the depths of springs beneath,
verses.33:14: and according to the season of the produce of the turnings of the sun, and from the conjunctions of the months,
verses.33:15: from the summit of the mountains of the beginning, and from the summit of the everlasting hills,
verses.33:16: and according to the season of the fullness of the earth; and may the favors of Him who appeared in the bush come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the crown of him who was glorified among his brethren.
verses.33:17: A firstborn of a bull is his beauty, and the horns of a unicorn are his horns; with them he shall gore the nations together even to the end of the earth. These are the myriads of Ephraim, and these are the thousands of Manasseh."
verses.33:18: And of Zebulun he said, "Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out, and Issachar, in his tents.
verses.33:19: They shall utterly destroy nations; and there you shall call out, and you shall offer a sacrifice of righteousness; for the wealth of the sea shall nurse you, and the commerce of those who dwell along the coast."
verses.33:20: And of Gad he said, "Blessed is He who enlarges Gad; like a lion he has rested, having crushed arm and ruler.
verses.33:21: And he saw his firstfruits, because there the land of the rulers was divided, when they were gathered together with the leaders of the peoples; the Lord executed righteousness, and His judgment with Israel."
verses.33:22: And of Dan he said, "Dan is a lion's cub, and he shall leap forth from Bashan."
verses.33:23: And of Naphtali he said, "Naphtali is an abundance of favors, and let him be filled with blessing from the Lord; he shall inherit the sea and the southwest."
verses.33:24: And of Asher he said, "Blessed above children is Asher, and he shall be acceptable to his brethren. He shall dip his foot in oil;
verses.33:25: iron and bronze shall be his sandal; as your days, so is your strength.
verses.33:26: There is none like the God of the beloved; He who rides upon heaven is your helper, and the Majestic One of the firmament.
verses.33:27: And the rule of God shall shelter you, and under the strength of everlasting arms; He shall cast out the enemy from before your face, saying, 'Perish!'
verses.33:28: And Israel shall dwell in confidence, alone upon the land of Jacob, upon grain and wine; and the heaven for you shall be clouded with dew.
verses.33:29: Blessed are you, O Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the Lord? Your helper shall shield you, and the sword is your boast; your enemies shall deal falsely with you, and you shall tread upon their neck."
verses.34:1: And Moses went up from Araboth of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the summit of Pisgah, which is opposite Jericho; and the Lord showed him all the land of Gilead as far as Dan,
verses.34:2: and all the land of Naphtali, and all the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah as far as the farthest sea,
verses.34:3: and the wilderness, and the surrounding region of Jericho, the city of palm trees, as far as Zoar.
verses.34:4: And the Lord said to Moses, "This is the land which I swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, 'To your seed I will give it.' I have shown it to your eyes, yet you shall not enter there."
verses.34:5: And Moses the servant of the Lord died in the land of Moab by the word of the Lord.
verses.34:6: And they buried him in Gai, near the house of Peor; and no one knows his burial place to this day.
verses.34:7: Now Moses was one hundred and twenty years old when he died; his eyes were not dimmed, nor were they impaired.
verses.34:8: And the sons of Israel wept for Moses in Araboth of Moab by the Jordan, opposite Jericho, for thirty days; and the days of the mourning of weeping for Moses were completed.
verses.34:9: And Joshua the son of Nun was filled with a spirit of understanding, for Moses had laid his hands upon him; and the sons of Israel heeded him, and did just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.34:10: And there has not arisen again a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,
verses.34:11: in all the signs and wonders, whom the Lord sent to perform them in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to his servants, and to all his land,
verses.34:12: the great marvels and the mighty hand, which Moses performed before all Israel.

notes.1:1: The Greek Septuagint renders the Hebrew geographical terms as "toward the west" (for Arabah), "near the Red Sea" (for Suph), and the Greek place names "Aulon" and "Catachrysea" (translating Hazeroth and Di-zahab).
notes.1:7: The Greek text reads "Antilibanus" (the Anti-Lebanon mountain range) rather than Lebanon.
notes.1:8: The Greek verb "He has delivered" stands in the third person singular before shifting to first person ("which I swore") within the divine speech.
notes.1:28: The Greek uses second-person pronouns ("Your brethren turned away your heart"), indicating that the people's direct lament ends after "Where are we going up?" and Moses resumes addressing Israel; "sons of giants" renders the Greek for Hebrew Anakites.
notes.1:40: The Greek uses an aorist indicative ("you turned and encamped") rather than an imperative, making this verse Moses's narrative report of Israel's departure after God's speech ends in verse 39.
notes.2:9: The Greek text reads "Seir" here and in 2:18, whereas the Hebrew Masoretic Text reads "Ar" (and "Aroer" in 2:29).
notes.2:20: "Zochomin" preserves the distinct Greek name form in this text corresponding to Hebrew "Zamzummim."
